jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager - B2B SaaS (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bei epilot gestaltest du direkt mit, wie über 200 Energieunternehmen ihre Produkte digitalisieren – von der Netzanschluss-Anfrage, über die Photovoltaikanlage bis hin zum Stromtarif. Wir suchen einen Product Manager mit echtem Product Mindset und dem Hunger, etwas aufzubauen – ob du dich "Senior" nennst oder nicht, ist uns dabei egal. Was zählt: wie du denkst, wie du entscheidest und wie ambitioniert du an deine Arbeit herangehst. Du verantwortest einen zentralen Produktbereich, arbeitest eng mit Engineering und Design zusammen und bringst datengetriebene Entscheidungen auf die Roadmap. Kein Konzernumfeld, kein endloser Abstimmungsmarathon – sondern echter Gestaltungsraum in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden SaaS-Scale-Ups der Energiewirtschaft.

epilot digitalisiert die Energiewirtschaft mit einer einzigartigen Cloud-Software. Wir sind ein wachsendes Scale-Up im Herzen von Köln. Unsere Mission: epilot revolutioniert die Zusammenarbeit aller Marktpartner, die in der Energiewelt zur Erbringung von Produkten und Dienstleistungen zusammenarbeiten. Wir bieten innerhalb der Cloudwelt ein großes Netzwerk aus Partnern, welches durch die Community ständig erweitert wird.


Das erwartet dich

  • Verantwortung deines Produktbereichs von der Strategie bis zur Auslieferung – mit voller Ownership über Discovery, Roadmap und Ergebnis.

  • Du arbeitest täglich eng mit einem cross-funktionalen Team aus Engineers und Designern zusammen und schaffst klare Prioritäten.

  • Übersetzung von Kunden-Feedback, Marktanalysen und Business-Ziele in konkrete Features – und du weißt, wann du etwas weglassen musst.

  • Du nutzt deine starken analytischen Fähigkeiten und dein tiefes Verständnis für unsere Kund:innen, um unser Produkt im Markt strategisch auszurichten und zu differenzieren.

  • Du triffst smarte Entscheidungen basierend auf der Auswertung von KPI’s, sowie Kunden- und Marktanalysen.

  • Hands-on im Code: Kleine PRs, Konfigurationsänderungen oder das direkte Testen im Code sind für dich kein Tabu – du verstehst, was unter der Haube passiert, und das macht dich zu einem besseren PM.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du denkst wie ein Entrepreneur – du verstehst unsere Business-Ziele und wie deine täglichen Entscheidungen diese beeinflussen.

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge: Features oder Produkte, die du von der Idee bis zum Launch verantwortet hast und auf deren Wirkung du stolz bist.

  • Kommunikationsstärke gegenüber verschiedenen Stakeholdern: u.a. Engineers, Sales, Geschäftsführung & Kund:innen.

  • Auf sich ändernde Bedingungen und Anforderungen reagierst du schnell, hast eine starke Do-it Mentalität und bist ein Mensch, der Unkonventionelles mag.

  • Deine kreative Denkweise ermöglicht es dir, innovative Lösungen für komplexe Probleme zu finden und Features zu konzipieren, die im Markt gebraucht werden.

  • Du bist ein TEAM-Player, motivierst und begeisterst deine Leute, um gemeinsam die gesetzten Ziele zu erreichen.

  • AI-Tools nutzt du aktiv in deiner täglichen Arbeit – sei es für Research, Prototyping, Datenanalyse oder das Schärfen von Anforderungen – und weißt, wie du sie sinnvoll in den PM-Prozess integrierst.

  • Du hast Erfahrungen mit den gängigen Tools des digitalen Projekt- und Produktmanagements, z.B. Jira, Figma, Miro, Power-BI o.ä. und agile Arbeitsweisen (Scrum/Kanban) liegen dir.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Sprache und Schrift.


Das bieten wir dir

  • Ein Produkt mit echtem Impact: Unsere Plattform beschleunigt die Energiewende – du siehst, wofür du arbeitest.

  • Start-up-Mentalität: dynamische Atmosphäre und großartiger Teamspirit.

  • AI-first Arbeitsweise: Wir setzen aktiv auf AI-Tools im Produkt- und Arbeitsalltag – von der Discovery bis zur Dokumentation – und geben dir den Freiraum, neue Werkzeuge auszuprobieren und einzuführen.

  • Ein stark wachsendes Unternehmen mit offener Kommunikationskultur, motivierten Kolleg:innen, und internationaler Unternehmenskultur

  • Exponentielle Lernkurve – epilot wächst rasant, selbiges erwarten wir von dir

  • Einen zentralen und modernen Standort im Herzen von Köln mit coolen Cafés direkt um die Ecke

  • Transparenz – Wir pflegen eine sehr flache und offene Unternehmenskultur, alles ist einsehbar und steht zur Diskussion.

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents wie bspw. zu Karneval, das Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, Company breakfast und noch viel mehr Gelegenheiten deine epilot:innen auch außerhalb der Arbeitszeiten kennenzulernen

  • Die Möglichkeit für mobiles, flexibles Arbeiten, Sportangebote (u.a. Urban Sports Club) u.v.m

Intro

We are looking for a motivated and technically driven Product Owner Infrastructure to join our product management team at Screening Eagle Technologies and take ownership of our Infrastructure inspection portfolio –measurement instruments (sensors, electronics) combined with embedded app software.   • Strong technical background, ideally with hands-on experience or solid foundational knowledge in optics development; experience with NDT or construction / civil engineering is a strong plus
  • Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into clear technical specifications for development teams

Our offer

  • Opportunities for professional development

jobs.title: Digital CS Program Manager
jobs.description:
About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 120+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

Thousands of customers, most of our customer base, work with Rentman without a dedicated Customer Success Manager. They sign up, set up Rentman and get to work, but not all of them get the most out of what they pay for, and today we mostly help them when they reach out to us. We want to change that. Your job is to make sure every one of them gets the most out of what they pay for, starting with new customers in their first months. Instead of adding CSMs at the same rate as we grow, we’re building a system of signals, plays and AI agents that helps these customers adopt Rentman, stay and grow with us. However, a human touch always stays: our pooled CSMs step in at the moments where a person makes the difference.

This is a new role and a new function, and you start as a team of one. You’ll build Digital CS from the start, with support from Data, Ops and AI engineering and a direct report to our Head of CX. There’s room to shape how AI agents are used in Customer Success, and a growth path towards CS or Revenue Operations.

What you'll do

  • Explore product usage, engagement, billing and support data in BigQuery to find which behaviour predicts adoption, churn or contraction. Turn those signals into trigger rules: what counts, from which threshold, at what moment and for which customer group. You build the data models behind these signals yourself, with our Data team reviewing your work.

  • Build automated plays across email and in-app messaging in tools like HubSpot and Chameleon, starting with new customers who haven’t adopted the product yet. You also automate the processes around your plays yourself, including AI steps. Every play defines when a customer goes to a pooled CSM, for example when there’s a cancellation signal or no response to the automated steps.

  • Every play runs against a control group. Ship a small version first, measure whether the effect is real or noise, improve what works and stop what doesn’t.

  • Write and maintain the customer communication for your plays across email, in-app and agent instructions, in language that fits our brand.

  • Shape agent specs and prompts that AI engineering builds from: tasks, rules, examples and when to hand over to a person. Define test cases and quality criteria, and check the agent’s work every week the way you would a team member’s.

  • Work with the onboarding squad, Content & Community, Product Marketing and RevOps so plays fit their designs and don’t clash with launches or product tours, and help decide which CS tools we build on.

Your first year

  • First 3 months: you find the first signals and set baselines together with our Data team.

  • After 4 months: your first plays for new customers are live, each running against a control group.

  • By the end of your first year: around 8 plays are live, at least 5 of them with a proven effect, and you’ve run a first pilot with an AI agent.

What we are looking for

  • 3+ years driving scaled adoption or retention for a large customer base, for example in scaled or digital Customer Success, CS or Revenue Operations, lifecycle or CRM marketing, or growth, at a SaaS or subscription business.

  • Proven experience turning product usage data into health scores, signals or lifecycle triggers.

  • A track record of one-to-many programs with results you can show in numbers, including how you knew the change came from the program and not something else.

  • No need to wait for an admin: you build workflows and sequences yourself in tools like HubSpot, or Chameleon.

  • Solid SQL skills: you write and read it independently.

Nice to haves

  • You’ve built a CS program or function from scratch (0 to 1), not only taken one over.

  • Hands-on work with agent specs or AI-supported workflows in a CS or support setting, and using AI daily for writing, analysis and testing while knowing its limits: wrong answers, privacy, and when a person has to step in.

  • A background in the live event, AV or equipment rental industry.

  • Experience in Git and pull requests

What you’ll get

  • Competitive salary based on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance

  • A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary)

  • 25 vacation days to recharge

  • Earn an extra day of PTO for each year at Rentman, from your second anniversary up to five years.

  • A 4-week paid sabbatical after 5 years to go on an adventure

  • Flexible WFH policy & work from anywhere for 4 weeks a year

  • Pension plan through BrightPensioen

  • An annual training budget to grow your skills

  • Access to OpenUp for mental well-being and personal growth

  • Your choice of a shiny new Windows, Linux, or Mac

  • Stay active with the team: join the Rentman football team, squash and padel, plus a discounted Urban Sports membership

  • An OV Business card if you live more than 10km from the office

  • An ambitious, inclusive, and diverse international team

  • A flexible, energizing workplace with free lunches, office perks (PS5, ping pong, D&D), legendary karaoke nights, and regular team activities

  • An amazing office in the heart of Utrecht, in the historic Drift 17

Our process

Here's a breakdown of our recruitment process to give you a clear idea:

  • Introduction call with the recruiter about the job & Rentman, online (30 mins)

  • Initial conversation with the hiring manager, online (30 mins)

  • Past Experience & Culture interview with the team, online (60 mins)

  • Take-home assignment (max 120 mins)

  • Final Skills interview incl. case presentation, on-site (90 mins)

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Product Manager - Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About our team:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our product team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

Job Summary:

As a Senior/Principal Product Manager - Infrastructure, you will own the roadmap, prioritisation, and delivery of the core infrastructure that underpins Radiant’s platform.

You’ll work closely with platform engineering, software engineering, networking, SRE, security, and infrastructure teams across Kubernetes, networking, storage, and shared platform services.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the roadmap, backlog, prioritisation, and delivery for Radiant’s core platform infrastructure.

  • Work with engineering teams to understand requirements across Kubernetes, networking, storage, compute, and shared infrastructure services.

  • Translate technical needs into clear initiatives, stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and priorities.

  • Manage work across new platform capabilities, upgrades, configuration changes, reliability improvements, technical debt, and security requirements.

  • Coordinate infrastructure lifecycle work including Kubernetes upgrades, network and SDN changes, storage platforms, load balancing, DNS, ingress, and shared platform services.

  • Identify cross-team dependencies, delivery risks, and infrastructure constraints that could impact product development.

  • Ensure infrastructure changes are planned with appropriate consideration for testing, migration, compatibility, rollback, resilience, and operational impact.

  • Partner with engineering to ensure the platform remains scalable, reliable, secure, observable, and maintainable.

Qualifications:

  • Experience in a technical product, platform product, infrastructure, or technical programme management role.

  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure.

  • Good understanding of infrastructure domains including:

    • Networking: SDN, routing, DNS, load balancing, firewalls

    • Storage: persistent storage, distributed storage, resilience, encryption

    • Compute: clusters, nodes, capacity, scheduling, scaling

    • Infrastructure-as-code and configuration management

  • Familiarity with tools and technologies such as Terraform, Helm, Argo CD/Flux, Cilium/Calico, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar.

  • Able to participate credibly in technical discussions and understand architecture, dependencies, and trade-offs without being the primary implementer.

  • Strong backlog management, prioritisation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Comfortable balancing feature enablement, platform reliability, upgrades, technical debt, and operational risk.

What you bring:

  • Infrastructure fluency: Understand how compute, Kubernetes, networking, storage, and platform services fit together.

  • Technical product management: Turn engineering needs into structured, prioritised work.

  • Systems thinking: Understand dependencies and downstream impact across the platform.

  • Prioritisation: Balance product delivery with reliability, maintenance, security, and technical debt.

  • Ownership: Drive infrastructure initiatives from requirements through delivery and rollout.

Our values:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Financial Statement Suite
jobs.description:
Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report.

Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off.

You'll own what FSS becomes across preparation and review cycles. You'll decide what sits on the teams roadmap and define strategy for this high opportunity area working with engineering, design, audit experts and the firms who use FSS every day.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

Outsight’s software solutions track the motion of people and vehicles using 3D LiDAR data.
Operators of transportation hubs like airports and train stations but also sport venues, road infrastructures and industrial sites can now access accurate and anonymous Spatial Intelligence data, in order to improve operations and increase user safety and satisfaction.
 
Our international team of scientists and engineers drive the development of our solutions from Paris, San Francisco, Sophia-Antipolis (Nice) & Hong Kong. To support our global outreach, we also operate a commercial office in Spain.
 
You can find below an interesting link about who we are and what we do :
Insights about Outsight
 
Our Passenger Flow Traffic Monitoring solution is trusted by the world’s leading airports and train stations across four continents, including the most renowned hubs celebrated for their operational excellence and exceptional passenger experience.  We also deploy our solutions in other markets such as Tourism, Retail and Sports.
Additionally, our Car Traffic Remote Monitoring product is trusted by several Tier 1 customers, including BMW.
 
Our Hybrid SaaS platform, SHIFT, turns raw data from Lidars and Edge AI appliances into actionable real-time insights—from optimizing passenger flow at international airports to ensuring safety in industrial zones. We operate a complex infrastructure spanning on-premise Edge devices, cloud backends, and end-user interfaces.
 
 
The Mission: Finding the Next "Airport"
 
Our core technology (Spatial Intelligence) is powerful, but we have only scratched the surface of its potential. Your mission is to explore Adjacent Markets to find our next major revenue stream.
 
You will act as a "Startup Founder" within Outsight. You will investigate verticals like Physical Security (Intrusion Detection), Retail (Shopping Paths), and Smart Buildings to answer two questions: Can we solve their problem? and will they pay for it?
 
Responsibilities
 
Market discovery: Get out of the building. You will interview potential buyers in new sectors to understand their pain points. You will map the competitive landscape (e.g., "Why would a Mall buy Lidar instead of cheap cameras?"). Hypothesis testing: Design experiments to validate willingness-to-pay in new markets.
 
MVP definition & prototyping: Leverage our existing Platform to configure "Vertical MVPs." You won't ask engineering to build a whole new product for 6 months; you will hack together a solution to test a hypothesis with a design partner in 4 weeks.
 
Go-to-Market Strategy: A Security Director buys differently than an Airport Manager. You will define the Packaging, Pricing, and Positioning for these new offers.
 
Pilot Management: Oversee the first deployments in these new sectors, acting as both PM and temporary Solution Engineer to ensure the first customers succeed.
 
Go/No-Go Decisions: You own the business case. You must be brave enough to kill a project if the market isn't there, or pitch for resources to double down if it is.
 
What are the requirements for the role?
 
5+ years in Product Management, ideally in an early-stage startup or an Innovation Lab environment.
 
Commercially Minded: You understand that a product is only successful if it can be sold. You are comfortable discussing ROI and budgets.
 
The "Zero to One" Mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity. You don't need a polished roadmap; you need a problem to solve.
 
Tech-Savvy: You can understand the capabilities of our Lidar platform well enough to know what can be "configured" quickly for a demo vs. what requires deep engineering.
 
Why join us? 
 
As a 7-time Gartner-recognized category-defining leader with dozens of global awards including “Edge AI Product of the Year,” “LiDAR Leader Award,” “CES Best of Innovation” and many more, we’re backed by 37 patents and deployments with the most prestigious (and challenging) customers across four continents.
 
Join our international team of world-class experienced engineers and business leaders solving humanity’s most complex spatial challenges, from passenger flow optimization to autonomous robotics coordination, while working at the cutting edge of 3D AI, LiDAR perception, and real-time analytics.
 
Supported by rock-solid investors including BNP Paribas, BPI France, Energy Innovation Capital and Demeter who back our long-term vision, this is your opportunity to shape how physical and digital worlds interact, with the resources, growth trajectory, and technical challenges that will accelerate your career in ways traditional companies cannot offer.

jobs.title: Product Owner für Agentic-Twin-Plattform explore (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Pfaffenhofen a. d. Ilm • Vollzeit • ab sofort

Wir sind EXP Software GmbH: Wir sind ein Team aus rund 25 Softwareentwickler*innen mit Herz, Humor und Leidenschaft für Technologie. Wir bauen explore, eine Agentic-Twin-Plattform, die Unternehmen dabei hilft, komplexe Prozesse durch autonome KI-Agenten abzubilden und zu automatisieren.Unser Produkt wächst und damit auch die Anforderungen an jemanden, der den Überblick behält: zwischen dem, was Kunden brauchen, was die Geschäftsführung vorhat, und dem, was das Entwicklungsteam realistisch umsetzen kann. Genau diese Brücke baust du. Wir suchen keinen Prozess-Verwalter, der Tickets schiebt. Wir suchen jemanden, der explore wirklich versteht, sich für das Produkt begeistert und mit Klarheit und Konsequenz dafür sorgt, dass die richtigen Dinge in der richtigen Reihenfolge gebaut werden.

Aufgaben

Produktvision & Roadmap

  • Du erstellst und verantwortest das Product Backlog für explore: Pflege, Priorisierung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung in enger Abstimmung mit Geschäftsführung, Kunden und Entwicklungsteam.
  • Du übersetzt Geschäftsziele und Kundenanforderungen in klare, umsetzbare User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien, und das präzise genug für das Team und verständlich genug für alle anderen.
  • Du setzt klare Prioritäten und begründest sie: Was bauen wir als nächstes – und warum?
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung eine mittelfristige Produkt-Roadmap und hältst sie am Leben.
  • Du durchdringst die explore-Plattform inhaltlich: Agentenlogik, Automatisierungskonzepte, Möglichkeiten und Grenzen und bringst Impulse aus dem KI-Markt direkt ins Produkt.

Team & Wissenstransfer

  • Du führst regelmäßige Gespräche mit Bestandskunden, verstehst ihre Arbeitsprozesse und erkennst, welche Anforderungen wirklich wichtig sind und welche nur laut.
  • Du übersetzt Kundenfeedback, Support-Erkenntnisse und Marktbeobachtungen in konkrete Produktentscheidungen.
  • Du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für eingehende Anforderungen und sorgst dafür, dass nichts verloren geht, alles bewertet wird und Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar sind.
  • Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich in deiner eigenen Arbeit: zur Recherche, Dokumentation, Analyse, Priorisierung und Automatisierung.

Zusammenarbeit & Steuerung

  • Du arbeitest täglich eng mit unseren Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern zusammen: Sprint Planning, Refinements, Reviews; du bist dabei und bringst dich inhaltlich ein.
  • Du beantwortest Rückfragen des Teams schnell und verbindlich, nimmst Ergebnisse ab und stellst sicher, dass sie den definierten Akzeptanzkriterien entsprechen.
  • Du verstehst technische Zusammenhänge gut genug, um sinnvolle Abwägungen zwischen Aufwand und Nutzen zu treffen.
  • Du planst Demos vor Kunden und Stakeholdern und führst diese direkt im Produkt auch selbst aus.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Software- oder Tech-Umfeld und weißt, wie agile Produktentwicklung in der Praxis funktioniert.
  • Eine Zertifizierung als Product Owner ist wünschenswert, aber kein Muss.
  • Du hast ein solides Verständnis von Softwareentwicklung und KI-Konzepten. Ein Informatikstudium oder eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker ist wünschenswert, aber nicht zwingend. Entscheidend ist, dass du mit dem Entwicklungsteam auf Augenhöhe kommunizieren kannst.
  • Du verstehst, wie LLMs, Agenten und Automatisierungssysteme funktionieren; nicht zwingend auf Code-Ebene, aber konzeptionell sicher genug, um Produktentscheidungen darauf zu gründen.
  • Du kannst gut zuhören, präzise zusammenfassen und Anforderungen so formulieren, dass sie das Team direkt umsetzen kann.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, priorisierst klar und verlierst auch bei vielen parallelen Themen nicht den Überblick.
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf allen Ebenen: mit Kunden, Entwicklern und der Geschäftsführung gleichermaßen und verwendest jeweils die richtige Ansprache.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung; Englisch ist im technischen Kontext selbstverständlich.
  • Wir wünschen uns jemanden, der hauptsächlich bei uns vor Ort ist. Mindestens 3 von 5 Tagen in unserem Büro in Pfaffenhofen. Remote-Tage sind selbstverständlich möglich und Teil unserer Arbeitsweise.

Benefits

  • Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit 30 Tagen Urlaub.
  • Flexibles Arbeiten und familienfreundliche Arbeitszeitgestaltung.
  • Ein kollegiales, wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Raum für eigene Ideen.
  • Budget für Weiterbildung und die Tools, die du brauchst.
  • Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wohin sich explore entwickelt - mit echtem Einfluss auf Produktvision und Roadmap.
  • Du arbeitest an einer Plattform am Puls der aktuellen KI-Entwicklung und hast damit Einfluss auf Architektur und Produktrichtung.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Schick uns:

  • Deinen Lebenslauf.
  • Optional: Nachweis deiner PO-Zertifizierung.
  • Optional: Ein kurzes Beispiel, wie du eine komplexe Kundenanforderung in konkrete User Stories übersetzt hast. Das interessiert uns mehr als ein klassisches Anschreiben.

Fragen? Wir melden uns schnell.

jobs.title: Product Owner (H/F/N)
jobs.description:
Les entreprises qui performent décident mieux. Depuis 2006, Ekimetrics aide les organisations à transformer leurs décisions en avantage concurrentiel durable grâce à des solutions d’IA. Notre double ambition est d’allier performance et durabilité, pour construire un leadership pérenne. 

Nos solutions sont une combinaison unique de People et de technologie. Notre plateforme Eki.Decisions complète l’expertise de nos équipes en marketing, efficacité commerciale et data science, pour connecter l’IA aux décisions qui structurent toute l’organisation. 

Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un avantage concurrentiel constant, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN. 

Vous rejoignez l’équipe Produit – R&PD 

Au sein de l’équipe R&PD (Research & Product Development) nous concevons et industrialisons des solutions Data & IA SaaS à fort impact business, qui répondent aux enjeux de nos clients grâce à l’analytics, la data science et l’intelligence artificielle.

A ce titre, nous recrutons un·e Product Owner pour notre solution Marketing Effectiveness avec pour objectif de structurer la  roadmap produit, maximiser son adoption, son time-to-market et la valeur délivrée à nos clients. 

Votre rôle dans l’équipe 

Product Owner de notre solution Marketing Effectiveness (Eki.Decisions), vous transformez les besoins business, marché et utilisateurs en fonctionnalités concrètes, documentées et alignées sur une logique de plateforme commune. 

Vous travaillez au quotidien avec le Product Manager, les équipes engineering et data, ainsi que les équipes projet et delivery, pour construire une solution fiable, adoptée et scalable. 

Vos principales missions 

Piloter le backlog et le delivery 

  • Structurer, prioriser et maintenir le backlog de la solution 

  • Rédiger les user stories, spécifications fonctionnelles et critères d’acceptance 

  • Clarifier les besoins avec l’engineering et accompagner chaque livraison de bout en bout 

  • Suivre l’avancement, lever les blocages et sécuriser les engagements 

  • Animer les rituels agiles : refinement, sprint planning, reviews, rétrospectives, synchronisations produit/tech 

  • Rendre la roadmap, les priorités et les arbitrages lisibles pour toutes les parties prenantes 

Contribuer à la vision produit 

  • Co-construire la vision et la roadmap avec le Product Manager 

  • Traduire les enjeux business et marché en opportunités produit concrètes : fonctionnalités, parcours utilisateurs, briques mutualisées, standards d’expérience 

  • Prioriser selon la valeur business, l’impact client, la contribution à la platformisation et la capacité à accélérer le time-to-market 

Participer à la product discovery 

  • Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs et des clients sur le Marketing Effectiveness 

  • Maîtriser les usages, comportements et règles métier qui font la valeur de la solution 

  • Identifier les enjeux fonctionnels et opérationnels : expérience utilisateur, cohérence des parcours, adoption, scalabilité, industrialisation 

  • Conduire ou contribuer aux activités de discovery : interviews, retours terrain, analyses d’usage, benchmarks 

Faire adopter et améliorer en continu 

  • Accompagner le déploiement des nouvelles fonctionnalités auprès des parties prenantes clés, avec une communication claire sur ce qui est livré 

  • Mesurer l’impact : adoption, satisfaction, valeur délivrée aux clients 

  • Animer la boucle de feedback avec les équipes Produit, Business, Tech et Delivery 

  • S’appuyer sur les outils de tracking pour monitorer les usages et prioriser de façon data-driven 

  • Garantir la qualité : documentation produit, release notes, support, monitoring d’usage 

Collaborer en transverse 

  • Travailler avec les équipes Produit, Tech, Data, IA et Delivery pour assurer la cohérence des solutions émergentes avec la plateforme 

  • Servir de relais entre les équipes business, produit, engineering et delivery 

  • Participer aux démonstrations, formations internes, retours d’expérience et communications produit 

Votre profil 

Expérience 

  • 3 ans minimum en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager 

  • Expérience sur des produits SaaS ou digitaux, idéalement dans un environnement data, IA ou tech

Compétences 

  • Forte appétence business : vous reliez les fonctionnalités à la valeur client et aux enjeux marché 

  • Aisance avec les profils tech : vous comprenez les enjeux d’un produit technique, sans avoir besoin d’être développeur·se 

  • Maîtrise du backlog : clarifier les besoins, prioriser des sujets complexes, suivre le delivery 

  • Logique de plateforme : mutualisation des usages, convergence des solutions, cohérence des parcours 

  • Sensibilité forte à l’expérience utilisateur, à l’adoption et à la qualité produit 

  • Capacité à vulgariser et à embarquer les parties prenantes autour d’une vision commune 

Savoir-être 

  • Organisé·e, rigoureux·se, autonome, curieux·se et orienté·e impact 

Langues 

  • Français et anglais courants, à l’écrit comme à l’oral 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?  

Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent: à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. 

Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.

Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.

En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.

Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 ! Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.  

Vous aurez accès :

  • Au catalogue de formation Eki.Academy qui contient des programmes qui vous feront monter en compétences sur nos solutions et nos métiers, des parcours apprenants sur notre plateforme digitale ainsi que des programmes dédiés à nos enjeux prioritaires, dont la sensibilisation aux sujets environnementaux avec la Climate School.
  • A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People.
  • De nombreux évènements et séminaires pour rester proche de votre communauté.

En tant qu’employeur, Ekimetrics offre à tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi sans distinction de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. Ekimetrics veille à développer un environnement de travail inclusif qui reflète la diversité dans ses équipes.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfilment
jobs.description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started.

Our Mission

For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry.

The Fulfilment & Express Team

The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world.

About the Role

As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead.

What would YOU be doing?

  • Setting the fulfilment strategy for the next 2 to 4 quarters, making trade-offs explicit, including what we are choosing not to do and why

  • Owning the roadmap and the numbers: running quarterly planning, sizing opportunities and setting targets for delivery-as-promised, delivery date accuracy and delivery speed

  • Making our Promised Delivery Dates trustworthy by rolling out SLA-based, dynamic delivery dates across every category and route, and shaping how they are used for delay communications and, in time, shown to buyers

  • Scaling Express, our hub-based fast-delivery offer, including hub workflows (receiving, inventory and RFID put/pick, QC and dispatch), ready-to-wear jewellery, consignment flows and speed options such as same-day pickup

  • Owning jewellery returns and on-platform QC, from the manufacturer through to the hub, including hallmarking and consignment returns to suppliers

  • Improving the delivery experience through carrier and rate/transit integrations, consolidation, last-mile cost and efficiency, and clear order visibility for buyers

  • Translating hub operations, carrier behaviour, customs and supplier handling into clear product requirements, designing for the exceptions as much as the happy path

  • Turning support tickets, delay breaches, supplier performance data and customer feedback into prioritised problems, then deciding what to build, buy or fix operationally

  • Partnering daily with Engineering and Design, and closely with Operations, Customer Support, Account Management, Sales, Supplier Experience and Fintech so delivery, credit and payments feel like one journey for the buyer

  • Writing sharp PRDs and decision records, and reporting progress openly through our weekly updates

  • Mentoring other product managers and designers on working in operationally complex domains

What do we need from YOU?

  • 5 to 8 years in product management, including experience owning a complex product area end to end

  • Experience in fulfilment, logistics, supply chain or other operations-heavy products. You are comfortable where software meets warehouses, carriers, SLAs and customs

  • Strong systems thinking: you can map a multi-party process, find where promises break, and design for failure modes, delays and edge cases

  • Data fluency: you define the right metrics, query and interrogate data yourself (Snowflake, Mixpanel or similar) and use it to decide what to build next

  • Sound prioritisation and commercial judgement: you weigh impact, effort and risk honestly, say no clearly, and can explain the return on a fulfilment investment to leadership

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership: you build trust with engineers, operators and commercial teams, and influence without authority across time zones

  • Clear written communication: concise PRDs, roadmaps and updates that make decisions easy

  • Customer and operator empathy, and high agency: you spend time with jewellers, support teams and hub operators, you take ownership, and you follow things through to the outcome

Nice to have

  • Jewellery, diamond or luxury goods experience

  • Marketplace or B2B commerce experience, ideally two-sided with supply and demand constraints

  • Experience with carrier or shipping APIs, rate and transit tools, 3PL integrations, inventory systems or RFID

  • Experience building predictive or SLA-based estimates, such as delivery dates or ETAs

  • Experience with cross-border shipping, customs, duties or compliance (for example hallmarking and HS codes)


Our culture and what we offer

Nivoda is collaborative, high-growth and built on empowerment. You will have real ownership from day one, a team that wants you to succeed, and the chance to keep learning as the company scales. We are remote-first with flexible hours, and we trust you to do your best work your way.


Our current benefits

  • ⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to join our DataFetch Team. 

What the team does

 DataFetch owns the engine behind every view in Pigment: how users access, explore and display their data. Our mission is to give end users fast, easy access to their data in whatever way suits them, and to give modelers the tools to build views that are robust and performant.
 We take block data (metrics, lists, tables) and turn it into what a view actually shows: preparing the query (pivot, scope, filters, aggregations), applying access rights, and shaping results ready to render.

Why it matters

 Views and boards are how most people consume Pigment. Every grid opened, every export run and every drilldown goes through DataFetch, so our work shapes the daily experience of both end users and modelers. And increasingly, agents and AI features rely on us as the data-access layer to retrieve customer data.

What you'll do
 
- Pitch our product to existing and new customers and collect their feedback through workshops, design sessions, UX research and discovery, together with other PMs and Designers
- Build the product vision and roadmap in close collaboration with Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing and Sales; secure the flows of communication between those teams so that everyone has the necessary support and information for customer communication and day to day prioritization

- Clear product strategy defined for your domain

jobs.description:
Auditors sign their name to every conclusion. An agent can do the heavy lifting, but only if the auditor can see how each conclusion was reached and trace it back to its source.

Agent Builder is where firms turn their own procedures into agents their whole team can run, in Alwin by DataSnipper, our agentic automation platform for audit and finance. Built well, an agent makes quality a property of the procedure, not of who happened to be staffed on the engagement.

You'll own Agent Builder and the agents firms build with it. Your users are the people at firms who build agents, and the methodology and quality teams who approve them for client work.

This is a technical PM role. You'll shape the harness each agent runs in: the context it sees, the tools it uses, and where a person reviews its work. You'll own the feedback loops that improve agents after release. You'll work as a peer to the Agent Builder engineering team, and with our Agent Runtime and Evals teams here in Amsterdam.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

The problems you'll own

  • A firm's procedure must become a harness an agent can follow, with the right context, tools and review points

  • Models are non-deterministic, but audit work must be defensible: traceable, attributed and reviewed

  • A firm will only rely on an agent it can test, approve and trace

  • Reviewer feedback must make agents better, with the firm's approval and without anything reaching another client

  • Methodology, models and standards all change. Agents in use must keep up without breaking work in progress

What you'll do

  • Own the Agent Builder strategy and roadmap, and make the trade-offs explicit

  • Design the harness with engineering: how context is assembled, how tools are defined and called, and where a person must review

  • Decide what builders control and what the platform sets, so agents can encode real methodology and stay consistent

  • Build the feedback loops: turn run traces and reviewer edits into eval cases, regression tests and changes the firm approves

  • Set the quality gates an agent must pass before release, and test every new model or methodology version before it reaches live work

  • Report agent quality with a stated method and sample

  • Prototype in code before you write specs. Then write short specs and decision memos that engineers can build from

  • Spend time with the firms that build and approve agents, and turn what our forward-deployed teams learn into product, not one-off fixes

What you bring

  • A technical background: software, ML or infrastructure engineering, or several years as a technical PM on developer or AI platforms

  • Hands-on experience shipping agent systems in production: context and retrieval, tool calling, orchestration, structured outputs, retries and fallbacks

  • Eval practice: building datasets, calibrating LLM judges against human labels, offline and online evaluation, and regression testing across model versions

  • Observability for LLM systems: traces, cost and latency, and classifying failures so you fix causes, not symptoms

  • System design skills: schemas, versioning, permissions, event logs and APIs. You can read a design doc and challenge it

  • PM experience on a product that other people build on

  • Prototyping in code with AI tools as part of your normal work

  • Clear, short writing

What sets you apart

  • Audit or accounting knowledge, from practice or from building products for auditors, finance teams or other experts in regulated fields

  • Document AI: extraction, OCR, grounding and citation

  • You've built an agent harness or framework, eval tooling, or LLM observability

  • You've built review workflows or feedback pipelines that turn user corrections into eval or training data

  • Experience with low-code tools, workflow designers, rule engines or DSLs

  • Design-partner programmes with large enterprise customers

What We Offer

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Deine Mission

Produkt und Design sind bei Bling eine Rolle.Du baust bei uns eigene Features, vom User-Problem bis zum Release. Du findest das Problem, entwickelst das Konzept, gestaltest die Lösung selbst in Figma und briefst sie übergabereif für die Entwicklung. Nach dem Launch schaust du dir an, wie dein Feature genutzt wird, und entscheidest, was als Nächstes passiert.

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Head of Product und trägst vom ersten Monat an die Verantwortung für deine Features.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst Ownership für eigene Features, von der User-Problem-Discovery über die Konzeption bis zum Launch
  • Du gestaltest die Lösungen selbst in Figma: User Flows und Screens auf Basis unseres Design Systems
  • Du übersetzt deine Konzepte und Designs in klare Tickets für unsere Entwickler und erarbeitest die technische Umsetzung gemeinsam mit ihnen
  • Du verantwortest Releases und stehst für die Qualität der gebauten Funktionen ein
  • Du erkennst Reibungspunkte in der User Journey und entwickelst Lösungen, die Conversion, Activation und Retention messbar verbessern
  • Du analysierst nach dem Launch die Nutzung, initiierst Experimente und A/B-Tests und leitest daraus die nächsten Schritte ab

Dein Profil

  • Du hast schon etwas gebaut und kannst es zeigen: ein Feature, ein Side Project, eine App. Ob aus ein bis zwei Jahren im Product Management oder Product Design oder aus starken Praktika, ist uns egal
  • Du hast Freude daran, Produkte zu skalieren, und willst sehen, dass sich deine Arbeit in den Zahlen zeigt
  • Du wartest nicht auf Aufgaben. Du siehst ein Problem, machst es zu deinem und lässt es erst los, wenn es gelöst ist
  • Du fühlst dich sicher im Umgang mit Figma und hast ein gutes Gespür für UX/UI und ästhetische Interfaces
  • Du denkst in der Konzeption schon die Umsetzung mit und kannst mit Entwicklern auf Augenhöhe über Lösungen diskutieren
  • Du arbeitest aktiv mit AI und weißt, wo sie dir Arbeit abnimmt und wo du besser selbst ran musst
  • Du übernimmst Ownership, arbeitest strukturiert mit Roadmaps, Tickets und Deadlines und hältst dabei ein hohes Tempo
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau und sehr gutes Englisch, lebst in Berlin und bist drei Tage pro Woche bei uns im Büro

Was dich erwartet

  • Echte Ownership: Deine Features landen bei über 150.000 Familien
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Head of Product, mit kurzen Wegen, schnellem Feedback und steiler Lernkurve
  • Ein MacBook und hochwertiges Equipment, damit du bestens ausgestattet bist, um erfolgreich zu arbeiten
  • Ein flexibles Hybrid-Arbeitsmodell, das dir ermöglicht, im Büro oder von zu Hause zu arbeiten – mit der Option, gelegentlich auch remote zu arbeiten
  • Subventionierter Urban Sports Club, ein Bling-Mobile Tarif und weitere Benefits
  • Ein modernes, lebendiges Büro im Herzen von Berlin Mitte mit einer voll ausgestatteten Küche mit kostenlosen Getränken, Frühstück, Snacks und unserer Siebträger Kaffeemaschine
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents, die unsere Unternehmenskultur stärken und jeden Erfolg noch schöner machen

Deine Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen CV und einen Link zu etwas, das du gebaut hast.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Consumer Growth builds mobile and web experiences that help people become Kraken customers, fund their accounts, invest, earn, access new products, build wealth and stay lifelong clients. Product, engineering, design, data, and lifecycle marketing build together.

 

The opportunity

  • Choose the right bets. Identify the client segments and problems worth solving. Own the roadmap and allocate effort against expected client value, commercial impact, and engineering cost. Set the baseline, target, and threshold for scaling; stop weak bets.

  • Build NTU retention. Help newly transacting users build on their first transaction, discover further value, and form repeat investing and financial habits through their first weeks and months. Find where they stall and improve the steps that lead to lasting use.

  • Retain and bring back established clients. Keep active clients engaged, address signs of lapsing, and reactivate clients who have stopped. Understand how needs change with tenure, holdings, and financial goals, then deepen the client’s relationship with Kraken.

This is account-led selling rather than opportunity-led. You run each account like a business, over years rather than quarters.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Got Drive? Join AnyVan as we make moving anything, anywhere miles better and build a career that moves just as fast.


Back in 2009, our Chairman Angus saw half-empty vans everywhere and knew there had to be a better way! That's how AnyVan began. He set out to create the world's most efficient logistics technology and help halve the number of wasted miles by filling those empty vans.


Since then we've become the nation's favourite way to move, with over 150k five-star reviews and 5 million customers in the UK and Europe. Our team of 400 AnyVanners across London, Cape Town and Bogota is proving that moving doesn't have to cost the earth by helping save 8,520 tonnes of Carbon each year.

Build systems that move the real world, with AI at the core

At AnyVan, we're building one of the most sophisticated logistics optimisation platforms in Europe. We connect customer demand with real-time driver availability, using intelligent matching, dynamic pricing, and AI to deliver a world-class service at market-beating prices.

By routing jobs to vans already on the road, we reduce wasted miles, cut emissions, and ensure drivers earn fairly. It's logistics, pricing, and marketplace dynamics, driven by software and increasingly by machine intelligence.

We're hiring for two Senior Engineer roles. Both sit in the same engineering team, share the same stack and ways of working, and put AI at the heart of what they build. The difference is the problem you'll focus on: one role is all about the AI agents behind our Sales and Customer Service teams, the other is about Allocations, getting our transport partners matched to the right jobs. Let us know in your application which one interests you most.


Role 1: Senior Engineer, AI Agents (Sales & Customer Service)

In this role, you'll help build and scale the AI agents behind our Sales and Customer Service teams. These agents handle real conversations with real customers every day, answering questions, qualifying leads, quoting moves and resolving issues across phone, chat and messaging.

You'll own them end to end, from designing how they reason and which tools and data they can use, to the evaluation, guardrails and observability that keep them accurate, on-brand and safe in production.

You'll work closely with our Sales and CS leaders and the agents who use these tools on the front line, so you can see the impact of your work in conversion, response times and customer satisfaction. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to move LLM-powered systems past the demo stage and into something thousands of customers rely on.


Role 2: Senior Engineer, Allocations

In this role, you'll work with our Allocations team on the data and back-end engineering problems behind how our transport partners access jobs, get booked and are allocated against the right work. You'll focus on the data, platforms and tools that make that happen.

This is the engine behind routing jobs to vans already on the road, so you'll see the impact of your work directly in how efficiently jobs are matched and how fairly drivers earn.



We move fast:
We're embedding AI and machine learning across our core platform, not as experiments, but as production systems that drive real business outcomes:

  • Real-time, intelligent pricing that models true job-level costs and responds dynamically to supply, demand, and market conditions

  • Predictive demand and routing models that forecast driver availability and optimise job allocation before a customer even books

  • LLM-powered tooling across our internal and customer-facing products, from intelligent quoting to driver workflow automation

  • A two-sided marketplace where drivers can buy and sell jobs to maximise utilisation — powered by smart matching algorithms

This is genuinely leading-edge work: production AI systems, at scale, on problems that matter.


How our engineering teams deliver

We're product-led and agile. Most teams run Scrum with two-week sprints, but we care far more about outcomes than rituals. Engineers are trusted to challenge assumptions, adapt processes, and ship things that matter.

Senior engineers here are not heads-down implementers. You'll:

  • Work closely with product, data, and commercial stakeholders

  • Influence technical direction and architectural decisions

  • Balance speed with long-term sustainability

  • Regularly ship meaningful improvements to production


Our technology

We're pragmatic and cloud-first, running on AWS, with the flexibility to choose the right tool for the job:

  • Exploring: Go, Rust, React, Node.js

  • Core stack: Python, Vue.js & Nuxt, TypeScript

  • Legacy (retiring where we can): Java, PHP, Angular

You don't need experience in everything, we value strong fundamentals and good engineering judgement over keyword matching.

What you'll be doing

  • Designing, building, and operating production-grade systems that scale

  • Tackling complex technical challenges across backend, infrastructure, data flows, and AI/ML pipelines

  • Writing clean, pragmatic, well-tested code with long-term maintainability in mind

  • Collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders to shape solutions

  • Championing testing, observability, and quality improvements

  • Mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar across the team


You'll thrive here if you have

  • Experience in a scale-up or fast-growing product environment

  • Strong backend engineering skills (Go, Java, Python, or similar)

  • A solid understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and performance

  • Experience with CI/CD, modern deployment practices, and cloud infrastructure

  • Comfort working with ambiguity and evolving requirements

  • A bias toward action — shipping value quickly, then iterating

  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to influence beyond your code

  • Bonus: exposure to AI/ML systems, Building AI agents, marketplaces, logistics, pricing, or e-commerce


Location and eligibility

  • UK-based, able to commute to Hammersmith. Happy to be onsite at least 3 days per week.

  • Please note we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role at this time.


What we offer

💰 Highly competitive salary
🌴 25 days holiday + bank holidays, Christmas Eve off, long-service perks up to 30 days
💪 On-site gym, Vitality membership, enhanced sick pay
📈 Pension – 5% employee / 3% employer
👶 Enhanced maternity pay
🚲 2 minutes from the tube, EV schemes, cycle-to-work, showers & towels
☕ Barista coffee, free breakfast, local discounts
🎉 Weekly drinks, socials, and unforgettable incentive trips
🚀 High ownership, real impact, and the chance to help shape a scaling platform

Our company values are:

  • Have fun, get it done

  • Progress over perfection

  • One team thinking big

You can find out more about our Company, Culture and Values here:

Our Careers Page

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace where every voice is heard, every perspective is valued, and every individual has the opportunity to thrive. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to be part of our mission and contribute to our vibrant culture.

Senior AI Solution Specialist
jobs.description:
Do you want to help an entire organisation turn AI opportunities into solutions that deliver real business value, while still being the person who gets hands-on and builds those solutions?

As Senior AI Solution Specialist at Sunweb Group, you take the lead on our more complex AI initiatives. You turn ambiguous business challenges into working prototypes and scalable solutions, while actively building, configuring and testing those solutions yourself.

You’ll join our five-person Architecture team and work closely with the AI PMO, connecting business teams with architecture, product, engineering, data and security.

This is a hands-on senior technical role, not a purely strategic, architectural or people-management position. Seniority here means tackling more complex challenges, having greater autonomy and impact, and helping others grow. We’re looking for someone who has recent practical experience building technical solutions and wants to continue doing so. You’ll design, prototype, configure, integrate and build, while also providing technical direction when needed.

Location: Rotterdam (Hybrid – 50% in office)
Start Date: January/February 2027

Availability: Fulltime

Your impact

  • Lead complex AI discovery
    Turn unclear, cross-functional or strategically important business challenges into concrete AI opportunities. Take them from problem definition and validation through to a working prototype.

  • Build AI solutions yourself
    Design, develop, configure and test agents, assistants and automated workflows that connect different departments, data sources and systems. You won’t only define what should be built or hand it over to others. You’ll be actively involved in building it.

  • Shape enterprise AI initiatives
    Identify when an AI solution needs to move beyond experimentation into a business-critical or customer-facing product, and work with product and engineering teams to make that transition successful.

  • Design for production
    Define solution architecture, integrations and non-functional requirements, while considering scalability, security, supportability, cost and business value.

  • Create reusable AI patterns
    Develop approaches for grounding, identity, integration, monitoring and evaluation that can be reused across teams, and identify opportunities for shared AI capabilities.

  • Coach and challenge others
    Review solutions, share technical expertise and coach colleagues and business users. You’ll work closely with our AI Solution Specialist and help raise the quality of AI solutions across Sunweb Group, while remaining an active builder yourself.

  • Strengthen responsible AI
    Contribute to our AI framework and guardrails, promote responsible use of AI and help create visibility around our AI initiatives.

Who you are

You’re curious, pragmatic and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You combine strong technical judgement with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You know the difference between an impressive AI demo and a solution that creates measurable business value. You enjoy working independently, bringing different perspectives together and sharing what you learn along the way.

Most importantly, you’re a builder. You enjoy getting hands-on with technology, experimenting, developing prototypes and turning ideas into working solutions. You may have led technical initiatives, defined architecture or coached others, but you haven’t moved away from building things yourself, and you don’t want to.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • A proven track record of delivering complex AI, automation, integration, data or cloud solutions

  • Strong solution design skills across applications, APIs, identity, data, integrations and cloud services

  • Experience taking ambiguous business problems from discovery through prototyping, testing and solution design

  • Experience defining architecture options, non-functional requirements and production readiness

  • The ability to translate between business needs and technical possibilities

  • Confidence working with business leaders, architects, product owners and engineers

  • Strong technical leadership skills, with the ability to review, challenge and coach others without stepping away from hands-on delivery

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector search and enterprise knowledge solutions

  • Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, OAuth, connectors and/or MCP

  • Development or scripting experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C# or PowerShell

  • Experience working with AI agents, assistants or orchestration workflows

  • Experience in the travel or tourism industry

Our technology

Our AI and technology landscape includes Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, Teams, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Azure AI services, Microsoft Foundry, ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude/Anthropic, MCP, Entra ID and Git.

Let us introduce Sunweb Group  

Sunweb Group is one of Europe’s largest online travel agencies, sending over 1.3 million holidaymakers annually to unforgettable destinations. Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. Our Fast Forward culture fosters focus and trust, enabling us to shape the future of holidays while helping our customers press pause and create lasting memories.   

Why join our journey?

  • Monthly gross salary between €6500,- and €8000,- plus 6 ATV days (based on full-time employment, excluding 8% holiday allowance). Please note: ATV days do not apply to part-time contracts.

  • Enjoy up to 20% off when booking with our brands for you, your family, and your friends.  

  • As an international company we support a hybrid way of working. We provide you with office furniture and IT equipment. 

  • We enjoy the journey so enjoy 25 holidays based on fulltime employment. 

  • Access to LinkedIn Learning and a personalized Reflect & Develop Plan to support your career growth.  

  • Benefit from coaching sessions designed to support your well-being.  

  • Receive work-from-home and travel allowances to ease your daily routine.  

Ready for departure? 

Do you want to become part of our team as Senior AI Solution Specialist? Click on “Apply”. Do you have any questions? Please feel free to reach out to our Talent Acquisition team via . We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Closing date for applications: 5 December

Sunweb Group is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate in any way. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
At Channable, we're building the future of eCommerce automation - and at the core of that vision is a world-class engineering organization. We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to join our Infra Platform Group, where you'll play a key role in scaling core infrastructure, empowering product engineering teams, and driving technical strategy.

🚀 About the role:

As a Senior Engineering Manager of the Infra Platform Group, you will manage two Haskell/Rust teams (Infra Blue and Infra Red) and one Python team (Python Infrastructure and Performance - PIP). The group consists of three team leads (your direct reports) who manage ~12 individual contributors in total.

These teams work on Channable’s core infrastructure, including services such as a data processing engine and a job scheduler. While scaling our applications to handle another order of magnitude increase in throughput with high speed and responsiveness is key, the work goes far beyond performance. You will focus on building new capabilities for product engineering teams, making their lives easier by delivering unified technical solutions across product groups, foreseeing infrastructure challenges, and collaborating directly with product engineering teams and the CTO to align initiatives with company strategy.

🛠 What you’ll do:

  • Drive the technical roadmap by balancing the work on scaling and performance with feature requests from the product teams

  • Quantify success by defining and measuring success metrics for the domain as well as team performance

  • Mentor and coach team leads to let them grow and excel at their jobs

  • Drive for high engineering standards by implementing good software development practices and challenging the team to come up with good designs

  • Maintain a high-performance culture through fostering accountability, being on top of performance management and focusing on employee engagement

  • Oversee and improve the hiring process for platform engineers

  • You work based on data when you can, and you ensure future decisions take data into account

💡 What we’re looking for:

  • Proven experience as an Engineering Manager leading team leads (preferred) or senior engineers

  • Ability to inspire and motivate a diverse team while managing performance and professional development

  • You have a history of being a software engineer and know how to build high-quality software and the trade-offs that are to be made

  • You are experienced with functional programming concepts, and are comfortable working with either Haskell, Scala, or Rust. Experience with Python is a plus.

  • Outstanding communication skills - you're just as comfortable talking to engineers as you are with stakeholders

  • You are collaborative, empowering, and adaptable - ready to take on challenges and contribute to strategic decision-making

  • A mindset focused on pragmatism and growth - you care about setting a high standard for yourself and your team and you continue to reflect to become more productive with minimal technical debt

Some practical things we expect from you:

  • You’re available for at least 32 hours per week

  • You're willing to come to our Utrecht office for two days/week

  • You have a valid work permit, and you're located in the Netherlands

Our Stack includes: Haskell, Python, Rust, PostgreSQL, Redis, Ansible, Terraform, React, Prometheus. And we run all of our infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform.


Important note: We understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow.

Note: The official job title for this role within Channable is Engineering Manager.

Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, and more than +40 nationalities.
Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, helping, taking ownership, and creating an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.

What do we do?

Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing.

Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/

And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like.

🌟 Why Channable?

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.


What do we offer?

  • Gross annual salary ranging from € 100k-120k, including the 8% holiday allowance and based on a 40-hour work week. 

  • Stock Appreciation Rights: You can financially profit from Channable’s success.

  • Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets

  • Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

  • Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth.

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year

  • Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

  • Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. 

  • Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. 

  • We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands!

  • Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources.

  • Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads.

  • Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more!

  • Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. 


How can you introduce yourself to us?

Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible!

Important note: In the current AI era, it's tempting to use technology to polish your interview performance. While we value your ambition, please do not use AI assistance during the screening process, so we can get to know the real person behind the resume.

Note: Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 for Make-A-Wish.

At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration, and we believe in a diverse and inclusive team
