jobs.title: Head of Product, UK SME
jobs.description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

The opportunity:  

Freelancers, contractors, sole traders and small business owners deserve an easier way to run their business finances. This is the next big focus area for Taxfix in the UK, and this role will shape our future offerings for this segment. As Head of Product for UK Self-Employed & SME, you will be responsible for understanding this customer deeply, setting the vision, shaping the roadmap, and rallying stakeholders to bring incredible customer experiences to life. This is a senior individual contributor role. You have no direct reports and you lead through vision, craft and influence. At Taxfix we call the people who own a problem from idea to shipped product, stretching across product, design and engineering with AI, builders. This is an opportunity to be a product leader and a builder.

Your responsibilities:

  • Own the vision, roadmap and outcomes. Set a clear product vision and strategy for UK self-employed and small business customers. Agree targets with leadership and your commercial partner and then own them and drive the key results. Make priorities clear and trade-offs visible.

  • Be the voice of the self-employed. Know these customers as well as anyone in the company, through direct contact, not distance. Be their ambassador in every decision.

  • Own discovery. Lead problem and customer need discovery so the builder teams always have well-qualified, relevant work. Bring your own well-informed ideas, not only a response to a brief.

  • Take a product from proof to pillar. Find product-market fit, pour fuel on what works, and make smart build-vs-partner calls, using shared capabilities where it is faster and building where it is core.

  • Drive adoption and depth of engagement. Make this the product customers rely on all year, not once. Own activation, retention and how widely customers use what we offer.

  • Build the AI-native product. Have a clear point of view on where AI removes real load for the self-employed and for accountants, and push the team to build what was not possible only months ago.

  • Run the team on experimentation and data. Make decisions with data, and with strategy and market judgement when the data is unclear. Speed to learning is a first-class metric you own.

  • Be the commercial partner, not the commercial owner. Shape the proposition with your commercial partner: tiers, pricing, packaging and bundling. Translate the commercial ambition into a product that delivers it, push back clearly when the product path and the ask do not align, and lead launches together with marketing.

  • Build responsibly in a regulated space. Work with compliance, financial crime and tax experts so that what you ship meets regulatory standards and is accurate, explainable and safe, including the edge cases and the risks that come with AI.

  • Set the bar for craft. Set direction for the teams you work with. Give them a vision sharp enough to act on and help remove handoffs and bottlenecks. Be entrepreneurial and lean in to build directly when needed. Credibility and influence matter more than authority.


Your profile:

Your track record

  • You have led product for a multi-team area, ideally for consumer or micro-SME customers, in a scale-up where you had fewer resources than you wanted and got things done by being hands-on.

  • You have taken a product from early traction to a real growth engine, with customers who rely on it, not just sign-ups. You can say why it worked, which metric moved and what you would do differently.

  • Experience in accounting, tax, or banking products is a strong plus, as is familiarity with UK tax, Making Tax Digital or HMRC-facing products.

 

You are a builder

  • You have built and shipped with AI yourself, not just written specs about it, and you know when to trust the output, when to edit it and when to reject it.

  • You use AI every day, and you are credible with design and engineering because you have built something end to end.

 

How you work

  • You are measured by outcomes and decide with data, and with strategy and market judgement when the data is unclear. You believe experimentation is how products win and treat velocity as a metric that matters.

  • You lead by influence: you have raised the bar for the people around you, with or without a team of your own, and people who worked with you got better.

  • You communicate clearly and concisely, with an ambitious vision for the product and a real curiosity about small businesses.

  • You have a bias to action, give feedback directly, own your misses, and are respectful, honest and kind.

Why Taxfix? 

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture.

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. We work with some of the world's leading enterprises across industries, helping them unlock the value of their knowledge, experts, technical expertise, inventions, and turn ideas into real-world impact. We're the builders of the new age of industrial innovation.

As a Deployment Strategist at Ankar, you'll help chart and build the art of the possible in enterprise R&D. Your mission is to discover where Ankar can create extraordinary value for our customers, and make that value a reality.

You'll immerse yourself in complex organisations, develop a deep understanding of their people, science, priorities and challenges, and uncover opportunities others might miss.

You'll bring curiosity, product intuition, commercial instinct and the ability to connect with people at every level of an organisation, helping them challenge established ways of working, imagine what's possible, and turn that ambition into action.

This isn't a traditional consulting, customer success or technical implementation role. You'll be part strategist, part operator, part product thinker and part builder. You'll need to be equally comfortable working with end users to understand their day-to-day challenges, shaping a proposition with senior executives, and collaborating with engineers to build something that doesn't yet exist.

You'll own outcomes, not just deliverables. From shaping an initial pilot to driving adoption, demonstrating impact and identifying opportunities to expand, you'll play a critical role in building Ankar's most important customer partnerships.

What You'll Do

Discover and unlock customer value

  • Immerse yourself in customers' businesses, workflows and strategic priorities to identify their most important problems and opportunities.

  • Connect the dots between customer needs, technology capabilities and commercial opportunities to define where Ankar can deliver the greatest impact.

  • Work with stakeholders from hands-on SMEs to senior executives, challenging assumptions and helping customers reimagine what's possible while building excellent rapport and passion for innovation to enable the work that’s needed.

Own deployments and drive impact

  • Lead customer engagements from early discovery and pilot scoping through deployment, adoption and expansion.

  • Develop trusted relationships across complex enterprise organisations, from end users to executive sponsors.

  • Partner closely with Account Executives to shape account strategy, build compelling business cases and turn successful deployments into broader enterprise partnerships.

  • Communicate complex ideas and results clearly, building conviction and momentum at every level of the organisation.

Help shape the product and how we scale

  • Act as a critical bridge between our customers and our product and engineering teams, translating real-world challenges into product insights and opportunities.

  • Identify patterns across deployments that can inform our product roadmap, new capabilities and future market opportunities.

  • Develop repeatable approaches, tools and ways of working that help us deliver extraordinary customer outcomes at scale.

  • Help shape the deployment function itself as Ankar grows.

What We're Looking For

Above all, we're looking for exceptional problem solvers with the curiosity, creativity, judgment and drive to make things happen.

You might come from technology, consulting, engineering, product, strategy or an entirely different background. What matters most is how you think, learn and operate.

We value:

  • Intellectual curiosity and analytical rigour. A love for getting to the bottom of complex problems, asking better questions and finding connections others miss.

  • Value oriented instincts where you naturally look for opportunities to create value, understand what matters to a business, and can connect technical possibilities to meaningful commercial outcomes.

  • Product intuition and technical fluency - excited by technology, comfortable getting hands-on with software and data, and able to work effectively with engineers. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be eager and able to learn.

  • Ownership and resourcefulness. A tendency to thrive in ambiguity, take initiative and find ways forward even when there's no established playbook.

Bonus points:

Why Ankar?

You'll join a small, ambitious team at a pivotal moment in Ankar's growth, working at the frontier of AI and enterprise industrial R&D.

You'll help shape not just how our technology is deployed, but how some of the world's most innovative companies work.

You'll have the opportunity to work directly with some of the world's leading companies, tackle genuinely complex problems and see the impact of your work firsthand.

You'll have real ownership from day one, a direct influence on the product we're building, and the opportunity to help define how Ankar works with customers as we scale globally.

If this sounds like you - sign up for the mission.

  • Our iOS app is written fully in Swift

  • We organise our components using the MVVM-C pattern

  • We use RxSwift for reactive data handling, with an ongoing migration toward Swift Concurrency

  • We use Factory for dependency injection

  • Screens are constructed with building blocks from our design system, built in SwiftUI

  • We use a layered modular architecture using Swift Packages to optimise scalability

jobs.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Opportunity

The CPO office at Prosus is deliberately small. Nalden sets the direction: what we build and why. Jons, as Chief of Staff, creates the traction: the operating model, the portfolio, the prioritisation, and the decisions that turn direction into shipped product. Around them sit product managers, product marketing, growth, brand, content and design, and three product pods that do the building.

What holds those two ends together is the work itself: every initiative visible, owned and moving, and every decision captured before it evaporates. That is this job. As Program Manager you run Nalden_OS — the operating loop of the CPO portfolio — day to day. You do not own the initiatives; you make sure each one has someone who does.

You join while that loop is being built rather than maintained, so you shape it: what gets tracked, how reviews run, what a decision record looks like, and which reporting we stop doing because nobody reads it.

In this role you will

  • Keep the whole portfolio visible, with an explicit owner on every line of work in flight across the CPO office and the product pods.

  • Prepare the decisions: shape ambiguous work until it is ready to be decided on, and prepare the prioritisation calls and operating reviews for the CPO and the Chief of Staff.

  • Make it move: track progress and dependencies across teams, surface blockers early, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a status update.

  • Make it stick: capture decisions and the reasoning behind them, keep the information people rely on accurate, and turn what teams learn into knowledge someone will reuse.

  • Build the view: a clean, reliable portfolio in slides, backed by a tracking system people actually update — assembled with AI so it takes an hour, not a week.

  • Be the honest signal: say early where the plan and reality have diverged, including when the useful version is the uncomfortable one.

What This Role Is Not

You do not make product decisions, approve teams' work, or become a reporting layer between teams and leadership. If teams spend more time updating you than shipping, the role is failing — and you would be the first to say so.

Who You Are

You are the person others trust in a messy week. When priorities shift and work stalls, you stay level, name what is actually happening, and get the loop closed. You follow up without nagging, and an unowned item bothers you until somebody picks it up.


You like order, but you fit the system to the work rather than the other way round. You build trust quickly across designers, engineers and executives, and you carry influence without authority: you move work through people who do not report to you. You are direct enough to raise the awkward problem early, and low-ego enough to let someone else take the credit when it lands.

What You Bring

jobs.description:
ABOUT US

At Heim, we are reinventing how healthcare is delivered.

We believe that healthcare is best delivered in the home of patients, and that we are at the cusp of a systemic shift away from hospital based care. Our mission is to expand access to in-person clinical care at home by empowering community nurses with technology that makes care delivery more efficient.

We have created an AI native ecosystem that optimises the complex scheduling involved in delivering community based care, and are on track to automate every non clinical touchpoint for nurses.

To date, our technology has powered our network of 400+ practitioners to deliver c. 30K appointments, and we have shown that our algorithms bring down the cost of at-home visits by c.35% whilst freeing up valuable time for care in doing so. We are growing fast and our ambitions are big – with new international markets on the roadmap, and strong investor backing.

Our aim is to create the most productive, AI-enabled distributed clinical workforce working at the intersection of public and private health.By joining Heim, you will play a pivotal role in building the infrastructure that puts clinical care in the home.

WHAT IT'S LIKE TO WORK AT HEIM

We are reinventing how healthcare is delivered. Here are the things that shape your day-to-day:

  • Meaningful problems – we build systems that improve how organisations understand and care for people. The work is complex, applied, and grounded in real-world patient impact

  • High standards, low ego – you’ll work alongside thoughtful engineers, clinicians, and operators who care about clarity and good judgement

  • Speed with intent – we move quickly but deliberately. Clear ownership, evidence-based decisions, outcomes over output

  • Simple, elegant solutions – we have a strong bias towards code that is easy to reason about, hard to break, and built to outlast the sprint it was born in

  • Direct access to founders – you’ll have visibility into and input on the direction of the company

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

This is a full-stack TypeScript role in the truest sense – you will own problems across the entire system, from UI to infrastructure. AI isn’t a feature here; it’s a first principle. We expect you to use agentic coding tools fluently (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) and to be building your own views on where agentic workflows can meaningfully improve what we ship.

You’ll be working on systems where the stakes are real: scheduling errors affect patient care, data quality issues affect clinical decisions, and downtime has consequences. That context sharpens every technical choice you make.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Design and build product features end-to-end across the Heim tech stack – owning them from first principles to production

  • Architect and implement AI-powered workflows: scheduling optimisation, practitioner dispatch, clinical data enrichment, and agentic referral automations that reduce manual touchpoints for nurses

  • Own the full lifecycle of features – from TypeScript frontend through to backend services, infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and testing – without relying on separate DevOps or QA teams to close the loop

  • Build and maintain the APIs, services, and data models that underpin clinical operations – with the reliability and auditability a regulated environment demands

  • Collaborate with our product and clinical ops teams to translate ambiguous real-world problems into working software

  • Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed and quality, and advocate clearly when the trade-off isn’t acceptable

  • Contribute to the architecture and infrastructure decisions that will shape the platform as we scale to NHS Trusts across the UK and into new markets

  • Leave the codebase better than you found it – improving performance, clarity, and resilience as part of everyday delivery

You won’t get perfectly specified tickets. You’ll be trusted to think, decide, and ship.

HOW WE WORK

  • Small team, fast loops, few layers – your decisions land fast and the feedback is real

  • We operate a hybrid team set up, and value high quality in person time so you must be able to commute to our central London office

  • Technical judgement is respected and expected – you’ll have a real voice in architectural decisions

  • Disagreement is normal. Good ideas win, not hierarchical ones

  • Strong bias toward execution: fewer meetings, clear ownership, and decisions grounded in evidence


WHO THIS IS FOR

You’re a senior full-stack engineer who acts like a founder. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. You’re comfortable roaming an unfamiliar part of the codebase when something needs fixing, and you’ll ask sharp clarifying questions before committing to an approach.

You probably have:

  • 6+ years building and owning production software in fast-moving environments

  • Genuine full-stack capability – you’re not “mostly frontend” or “mostly backend”; you care about and can own the whole system

  • Proven ability to own the full delivery lifecycle: frontend, backend, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, deployment, and testing – without handing off to separate DevOps or QA teams

  • Active, fluent use of AI coding tools – Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot – not as novelty, but as default workflow

  • Experience making data-sensitive engineering decisions: you instinctively ask about PII classification, schema flexibility, and audit requirements before you build

  • A track record of shipping under ambiguity – you’ve taken a vague ask, formed a point of view, and delivered something that worked

  • The judgement to know when to move fast and when to slow down

Bonus if you have:

  • Experience in regulated environments (healthcare, fintech, legal) and an understanding of what “good enough” looks like when data sensitivity is high

  • Background building agentic or multi-step AI workflows in production

  • A side project or personal tool built with AI – something that shows you’ve been hands-on with Cursor, Claude Code, or AI integrations outside of work

  • Familiarity with NHS data standards, FHIR, or community care systems

Infrastructure and cloud experience (GCP or equivalent) beyond the basics

jobs.description:
We are looking for a seasoned Senior Security Engineer, focused on AI & Application Security, to join our Platform team in Amsterdam. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll take a proactive, hands-on, senior role securing our agentic AI products, owning an emerging and fast-growing area of security engineering, the risks that come specifically from building with LLMs and autonomous agents, while helping raise the bar on our broader application security practices.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.



What You Will Do

  • Own AI-specific security as a discipline at DataSnipper: identify, assess, and mitigate the risks unique to LLM-based and agentic systems across our products and platform.

  • Translate security policies and risk requirements into concrete technical controls, standards, and guardrails, in partnership with Legal and technical teams.

  • Build a proactive AI security practice grounded in frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the broader OWASP GenAI Security Project (including agentic security), MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and adapt them to how we build.

  • Threat model our agentic features and pipelines, covering prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, data and model poisoning, insecure output handling, excessive agency, supply-chain risk, and unsafe tool and API use.

  • Red team our AI systems, probing models, prompts, agents, and integrations for weaknesses before attackers do, and turn findings into concrete fixes and guardrails.

  • Design and help implement guardrails, input/output validation, sandboxing, least-privilege tool access, and monitoring for AI and agent behavior.

  • Embed security into how we build AI, shifting security left through secure-by-design guidance, secure SDLC practices, and design and code reviews for AI features.

  • Partner with product and engineering teams to make secure AI the default, providing patterns, tooling, and guidance rather than after-the-fact gatekeeping.

  • Strengthen our overall security engineering posture alongside the SRE team, contributing to our SOC 2 and compliance efforts (e.g. via Vanta), CI/CD security gates, and the principle that vulnerable code cannot get deployed.

  • Own our vulnerability management process: identify and prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk, drive remediation across engineering and platform teams, track findings to closure, and fix recurring findings at the root.

  • Strengthen identity and access management, secrets management, and encryption across our products and platform, including the credentials and access that agents and AI integrations depend on.

  • Establish detection, logging, and incident response practices for AI-specific threats, and help the team respond when they occur.

  • Stay ahead of a rapidly evolving threat landscape and continuously raise the bar for how we secure AI.

  • Promote secure development practices through developer guidance and trainings, awareness initiatives, and collaboration with engineering teams.

What You Bring

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in security engineering, application security, or a closely related field, with a track record of owning security work end to end in production.

  • Strong grounding in application and cloud security fundamentals: threat modeling, secure design, common vulnerability classes, and secure SDLC practices.

  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, API Security, Threat Modeling and Vulnerability Management.

  • Hands-on experience with identity and access management, secrets management, and encryption implementations.

  • Demonstrated interest and hands-on experience in AI/LLM security, whether through professional work, research, red teaming, CTFs, or personal projects, and familiarity with frameworks like the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications or MITRE ATLAS.

  • Solid understanding of how LLM-based and agentic systems work in practice, including prompts, tool/function calling, retrieval, and agent orchestration, and where they break.

  • Proficiency in a scripting or programming language (Python preferred) to build tooling, automate checks, and prototype mitigations.

  • Experience securing cloud-native systems, ideally on Azure, including CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub) and infrastructure-as-code.

  • A proactive, builder mindset; you prevent problems by shipping guardrails and enabling teams, not just by finding issues.

  • Strong communication skills; able to explain AI-specific risks and tradeoffs to engineers, product managers, and leadership.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-moving scale-up, set technical direction, influence without authority, and mentor other engineers while defining a practice that doesn't yet have a playbook.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience red teaming or pentesting AI/LLM systems.

  • Familiarity with the OWASP GenAI Security Project's agentic security work and emerging standards for securing autonomous agents.

  • Experience with AI security tooling such as guardrail frameworks, LLM firewalls, prompt-injection scanners, or AI red-teaming tools.

  • Experience implementing security controls in production agentic systems, including sandboxing, least-privilege tool access, and runtime monitoring.

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and tools like Vanta.

  • Experience with observability and monitoring tooling (e.g. Grafana).

  • Relevant security certifications (e.g. OSCP, GIAC, or AI-security-specific credentials).

  • Experience in fintech, audit technology, or other regulated, trust-sensitive domains.

  • Familiarity with responsible AI, model governance, or AI safety concepts.

What We Offer:

  • Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact

  • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth

  • Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary

  • Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energized

  • Engage with a vibrant international team spread across five global offices

  • Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together

jobs.title: Delivery Director
Staff Software Engineer, OTA Platform
jobs.description:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

The Over-the-Air (OTA) Platform team builds the software delivery backbone for the vehicle: firmware updates, ECU configuration management, and software/hardware compatibility validation across the vehicle's compute and ECU landscape. The Germany-based OTA engineering group works in close, daily collaboration with the core OTA development team headquartered in Palo Alto, California, extending platform architecture to European vehicle programs and regional ECU suppliers, and representing site-specific requirements back into the global roadmap.

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to anchor and grow our Over-the-Air (OTA) engineering capability at our Germany site. In this role, you will own architecture-level decisions for OTA features spanning firmware updates, configuration updates, and software/hardware mismatch handling, working in tight lockstep with the OTA development team in Palo Alto. You will be the senior technical voice for OTA in Germany — driving site development activities, setting technical direction, mentoring engineers, and ensuring the Germany team's contributions integrate cleanly into a single, global OTA architecture.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed.

Responsibilities

  • Develop OTA features and services covering firmware update delivery, ECU/software configuration updates, and software-hardware mismatch detection and remediation.

  • Collaborate daily with the OTA development team in Palo Alto on system architecture, API contracts, and release planning; ensure Germany-site work streams stay aligned with the global OTA roadmap.

  • Design update strategies (full-image, delta/differential, A/B partitioning) that guarantee safe, resumable, and rollback-capable updates across heterogeneous ECUs.

  • Define and evolve the software/hardware compatibility (mismatch) framework, including version dependency graphs, pre-condition checks, and campaign eligibility rules.

  • Drive interface and contract discussions with cloud/backend teams (campaign orchestration, telemetry ingestion, update eligibility services) to keep vehicle-side and cloud-side assumptions in sync.

  • Work with communication protocol stacks used for in-vehicle and vehicle-to-cloud data exchange (e.g., UDS/ISO 14229, DoIP, SOME/IP, CAN/CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, TLS/mTLS, MQTT) to integrate OTA services with ECUs and cloud endpoints.

  • Ensure OTA processes meet automotive security and safety expectations: secure boot, cryptographic signing/verification, key management, and compliance-oriented practices aligned with ISO/SAE 21434 and UNECE R156 (Software Update Management System).

  • Partner with QA, functional safety, cybersecurity, and vehicle integration teams to validate updates through bench, HIL, and vehicle-level testing.

  • Support root-cause analysis and resolution of field issues related to update failures, mismatches, or rollback scenarios.

  • Take a leading role in architecture reviews and design decisions for the global OTA platform, representing Germany-site needs and constraints while upholding overall system coherence.

  • Drive Germany-site development activities end-to-end: technical planning, design reviews, code quality standards, and delivery execution.

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to Senior and mid-level engineers on the Germany team; review designs and code for correctness, performance, and maintainability.

  • Identify architectural risks and technical debt early; propose and lead initiatives to address them across the OTA stack.

  • Act as a key escalation point for complex, cross-cutting technical issues spanning firmware, middleware, and cloud interfaces.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time in embedded, systems, or automotive software.

  • Demonstrated experience owning system or platform architecture for a production software product, ideally in automotive, IoT, or another safety- or reliability-critical domain.

  • Track record of leading technical initiatives across multiple engineers or teams, including cross-site or cross-organization collaboration.

  • Experience directly interfacing with a partner engineering team in a different location/time zone to align on architecture and delivery.

  • Strong, hands-on proficiency in C++ and Rust — this is a core, non-negotiable requirement, as the majority of OTA services are implemented in these languages.

  • Solid understanding of embedded Linux / POSIX-compliant operating environments and the constraints of resource-limited automotive compute platforms.

  • Practical experience with in-vehicle and vehicle-to-cloud communication protocols (e.g., CAN/CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP, UDS/DoIP, TLS, MQTT, gRPC/Protobuf, or comparable).

  • Comfortable driving technical interface discussions directly with cloud/backend engineering teams — defining APIs, data contracts, and failure-handling behavior across the vehicle-cloud boundary.

  • Experience with version control, code review workflows, and CI/CD for embedded or systems software.

  • Working knowledge of cryptographic concepts used in secure software delivery: digital signatures, certificate/key management, and secure boot chains.

  • Strong debugging skills across layers — application logic, OS/driver interaction, and hardware/bus-level communication.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Fluent English (spoken and written) for daily collaboration with the Palo Alto team; German language skills are a plus for local site interactions.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to Palo Alto, CA (or host virtual overlap hours) to support cross-site architecture and planning.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience specifically in OTA/software update systems for vehicles or other connected embedded devices.

  • Experience establishing or scaling a new engineering site or team within a larger, distributed organization.

  • Exposure to Machine Learning / AI techniques applied to edge compute — e.g., anomaly detection on update telemetry, predictive mismatch detection, or on-device inference constraints.

  • Automotive middleware development experience on POSIX-based ECUs (e.g., AUTOSAR Adaptive, Linux-based domain/zone controllers, or similar middleware frameworks).

  • Familiarity with Yocto/embedded Linux build systems and board support packages.

  • Experience with functional safety practices (ISO 26262) and automotive cybersecurity standards (ISO/SAE 21434).

  • Knowledge of software bill of materials (SBOM) tooling and dependency/version management at fleet scale.

  • Experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test environments and automotive diagnostic tooling.

  • Familiarity with containerization or virtualization on embedded targets (e.g., lightweight containers, hypervisors) for update isolation.

  • Prior experience in a distributed/multi-site engineering organization, including asynchronous collaboration across time zones.

Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

As Expansion Lead, you will join our Strategy team, working directly with our Head of Strategy, Tine von Villiez, to drive Upvest's expansion into new markets and scale our presence in existing ones. jobs.title: Senior Process Autoreverse and Quality Manager
jobs.description:
The Senior Process Autoreverse and Quality Manager owns the standard, performance and quality of the Autoreverse process, from vehicle receipt through initial disassembly and handover to downstream activities. 

The role supports the four Operations sites, works daily with the Operations Managers and interfaces with the Product Manager to ensure that process, quality and product requirements are aligned. The objective is to deliver a safe, repeatable and scalable process for the A2MAC1 Data Factory. 

The role contributes to the Operations 2030 plan with the Transformation Project Team and helps build a common quality logic across processes and sites, based on shared principles, standards, routines and performance measures. 

As Senior Process Autoreverse and Quality Manager your main challenges will be to: 

  • Standardize the Autoreverse process and quality expectations across four Operations sites. 
  • Improve first-time-right performance while protecting safety, throughput and delivery. 
  • Reduce rework, damage, missing parts and process variation. 
  • Build a common performance and quality baseline with comparable data across sites. 
  • Prepare the process for higher volumes, new vehicle architectures and Operations 2030. 

RESPONSABILITIES 

1. Process Standards and Methods 

  • Own and maintain the end-to-end Autoreverse standard operating model. 
  • Define standard work, process instructions, checklists and escalation rules for the four sites. 
  • Ensure that process interfaces with scanning, photography, Advanced Services and data preparation are clearly defined. 
  • Identify and deploy practical improvements in methods, tools, workstation organization and flow. 

2. Quality and Continuous Improvement 

  • Define quality criteria and monitor defects, rework, missing components, damage and deviations. 
  • Lead root-cause analysis and corrective action plans with Operations and Quality. 
  • Verify the effectiveness of actions and prevent recurrence through standardization and error-proofing. 
  • Promote a first-time-right culture in all four sites. 

3. Operations Performance 

  • Define and monitor KPIs for safety, quality, lead time, throughput, productivity, rework and cost per vehicle. 
  • Run regular performance reviews with the Operations Managers and escalate risks or gaps. 
  • Use data to prioritize improvement actions and compare performance across sites. 
  • Support daily operations when process or quality issues require technical analysis. 

4. International Coordination and Deployment 

  • Coordinate the consistent deployment of process and quality standards across the four Operations sites. 
  • Build a common operating rhythm for process reviews, audits, lessons learned and action tracking. 
  • Develop and deploy common quality principles, standards, routines and indicators across processes and sites. 
  • Share best practices between sites and support local teams during implementation and ramp-up. 
  • Account for local constraints while protecting the global process standard. 

5. Product and Industrialization Interface 

  • Work with the Product Manager to translate product and vehicle evolution into operational process requirements. 
  • Assess the impact of new vehicle architectures, components and product changes on Autoreverse methods and quality. 
  • Provide operational input to new tools, equipment, software, automation and Data Factory initiatives. 
  • Validate that solutions are practical, safe, cost-effective and scalable before wider deployment. 

6. Operations 2030 and Transformation Contribution 

  • Contribute to the Operations 2030 roadmap with the Transformation Project Team and the Global Process Transformation Manager. 
  • Translate transformation priorities into practical process, quality and capability improvements for Autoreverse. 
  • Support POQs and improvement initiatives that can be standardized and deployed across the four sites. 
  • Provide operational feedback on automation, digitalization and Data Factory initiatives. 

7. Team Capability, Safety and Governance 

  • Train and coach teams on standard work, quality requirements and safe operating practices. 
  • Develop competency assessments and practical onboarding for critical Autoreverse activities. 
  • Identify process, quality and safety risks and coordinate mitigation actions. 
  • Maintain clear documentation and ensure that process changes are communicated and implemented. 

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS 

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in industrial engineering, mechanical engineering, manufacturing, quality, operations management or a related discipline. 
  • Professional background: Approximately 5 years of experience in automotive, manufacturing, industrial operations, quality or process improvement. 
  • Experience in a hands-on production, workshop, laboratory or technical operating environment. 
  • Experience with quality tools, process audits, structured problem solving and corrective action plans. 
  • Experience coordinating improvement activities across several teams or sites is preferred. 
  • International exposure: Experience working with multicultural teams or across multiple operating locations. 
  • Lean, Six Sigma, quality or project management certification is an advantage. 

SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES 

  • Hands-on operational leadership in an industrial or technical environment. 
  • Strong quality and continuous improvement mindset, with practical root-cause and corrective-action experience. 
  • Ability to standardize processes and deploy them consistently across multiple sites. 
  • Analytical approach to KPIs, process performance and operational problem solving. 
  • Ability to work effectively with Operations Managers, Product, Quality and technical teams. 
  • Structured, pragmatic and able to influence without relying only on formal authority. 
  • Professional English; French or another A2MAC1 operating language is an advantage.

Meal vouchers

Holiday bonus

Employee profit-sharing bonus

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
jobs.description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Hawk builds AI-powered financial crime detection (AML, transaction monitoring, and fraud prevention) for global tier-1 banks, payment processors, and high-growth fintechs. Because our platform analyzes real-time payment streams and sensitive financial data, security is not an administrative support function—it is our primary product promise.

We are looking for a technically grounded, hands-on CISO to own our global security posture end-to-end. This is a true player-coach leadership role. You will lead a dedicated team of four domain specialists while staying close enough to the technology to review cloud architecture, triage high-severity vulnerabilities, command critical incident responses first-hand, and debate technical security controls peer-to-peer with customer bank CISOs.

Why This Role Matters

  • Global Regulatory Scrutiny at Scale: We operate across key financial hubs including Germany, the UK, the US, Singapore, and a growing roster of international markets. With DORA enforceable across the EU and heightened ICT risk rules globally, our banking clients expect documented operational resilience, continuous testing, and verified controls across all jurisdictions.

  • Modern Attack Surfaces & Supply Chain Threats: Our multi-tenant and single-tenant cloud environments (AWS/GCP) process massive transaction throughput. Alongside defending against emerging supply chain vulnerabilities—from open-source dependencies to third-party build pipelines—you will need to deeply understand our AI approach and actively help harden our tooling, harnesses, and pipelines.

  • Enterprise Deal Velocity: Enterprise security reviews can either stall deals or close them. You will partner with our commercial teams to turn security questionnaires, risk mitigation, and architecture audits into enterprise trust and closed contracts.

Organizational Structure: The Four Domains

You will lead, mentor, and set technical direction for four specialized functional areas:

  1. Application Security: Secure SDLC, automated CI/CD security gates (SAST/DAST/SCA), software supply chain defense, secure coding standards, AI harnesses and pipeline hardening.

  2. Corporate Security: Zero Trust architecture, IAM/SSO, distributed endpoint defense (EDR/XDR), threat hunting, infrastructure access.

  3. Compliance & Governance: DORA implementation, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), multi-jurisdiction regulatory audits, risk registry ownership.

  4. Data Protection: Solely dedicated to data protection: GDPR compliance, privacy governance, data subject rights, and statutory privacy regulatory requirements.

Core Accountabilities

1. Hands-On Technical Leadership, Engineering Integration & AI Hardening

  • Secure Coding Standards & SDLC: Establish and enforce secure coding baselines directly within engineering workflows. Ensure automated vulnerability scanning, SBOM tracking, and security gates are integrated into GitHub/GitLab CI/CD pipelines.

  • Software Supply Chain Defense: Protect build systems, dependencies, and deployment pipelines against supply chain tampering, compromised packages, and upstream vulnerabilities.

  • AI Tooling & Pipeline Hardening: Deeply understand our AI approach and work closely with engineering to harden our systems. Personally evaluate and implement protective mechanisms—including secure AI harnesses, container sandboxing, and runtime guardrails around AI tooling and workflows.

  • Vulnerability Lifecycle Management: Set strict remediation SLAs for CVEs and cloud misconfigurations. Directly arbitrate vulnerability severity, triage zero-days, and collaborate with engineering leads to ensure rapid remediation without stalling release velocity.

  • Zero Trust & Cloud Infrastructure: Architect and drive our group-wide Zero Trust roadmap across AWS and GCP environments, enforcing least-privilege IAM policies, network micro-segmentation, and secure developer access.

2. Commercial Trust & Customer Engagement

  • Peer-to-Peer Customer Dialogue: Act as the senior technical authority in enterprise sales cycles, engaging directly with bank CISOs, InfoSec panels, and procurement leads to validate Hawk's architecture, threat models, and operational controls.

  • Accelerating Enterprise Deal Velocity: Modernize vendor due diligence by replacing reactive security questionnaires with standardized evidence packages, continuous compliance portals, and pre-packaged architectural audits that win customer confidence quickly.

  • Converting Security into a Value Driver: Turn our robust security baseline into a core sales differentiator, helping commercial teams demonstrate to prospect banks why Hawk's defense posture makes us their lowest-risk vendor.

3. Risk Registry, Compliance & Governance Leadership

  • Company Risk Registry Ownership: Act as the executive owner of the company-wide Risk Registry. Go beyond cataloging risks: prioritize exposures dynamically, secure cross-functional executive buy-in to fund and execute mitigations, and transform risk management into concrete business enablement and revenue protection.

  • Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM): Oversee vendor risk tiering, supply chain vetting, and continuous monitoring for third-party vendors and cloud sub-processors, executed directly through the Compliance function.

  • Audit & Regulatory Leadership: Maintain existing ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II programs with zero major non-conformities across an expanding international perimeter.

  • DORA Implementation: Enforce end-to-end compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act—specifically ICT risk management, third-party vendor oversight, operational resilience testing, and ICT incident reporting.

  • Multi-Jurisdiction Alignment: Adapt policies proactively to meet global financial standards across the EU, UK, US, Singapore, and upcoming expansion markets.

  • Executive & Board Reporting: Translate technical cyber risks into clear business metrics (KRIs, risk heat maps, burn-down rates) for the CEO and Board of Directors.

4. Frontline Incident Response & Operational Resilience

  • First-Hand Incident Commander: Serve as the hands-on incident commander during Sev-1/Sev-2 security incidents. Lead technical investigations, root-cause analyses, log forensics, and technical debriefs directly alongside your team.

  • Breach Notification & External Escalation: Direct regulator, law enforcement, and client communications within mandatory statutory windows under GDPR and DORA guidelines.

  • Testing & Tabletop Drills: Design and execute technical red team engagements, threat-led penetration tests (TLPT), and crisis simulations with both technical engineers and the executive board.

12-Month Success Metrics:

  1. Commercial Velocity: Enterprise bank security assessments clear with zero high-severity blockers, accelerating enterprise contract closures.

  2. Proactive Risk Registry: The company risk registry is fully operationalized with executive buy-in, systematically driving down enterprise risk while supporting business expansion.

  3. Regulatory & Audit Record: DORA compliance program is operational; ISO 27001 and SOC 2 renew cleanly across all operating regions.

  4. Engineering & AI Hardening: Software supply chain security controls, secure coding standards, and AI harness guard rails are fully integrated into engineering CI/CD workflows.

  5. Resilient Team Operations: The four-person security team executes with high autonomy, defined KPIs, and high cross-functional trust across the company.

Candidate Profile:

  • Practitioner Foundations: Proven background as a hands-on security practitioner (e.g., former security engineer, AppSec specialist, cloud security architect, or technical penetration tester) who has advanced into security leadership.

  • Player-Coach Track Record: Demonstrated ability to manage and grow a small team of domain experts while personally reviewing technical configurations, auditing cloud policies, or investigating an alert.

  • Commercial & CISO-to-CISO Fluency: Experience debating architecture, supply chain controls, and threat postures directly with enterprise bank CISOs and security evaluation boards to clear deal roadblocks.

  • AI & Supply Chain Defense Fluency: Ability to quickly understand our AI architecture, implement hands-on controls to harden AI tooling (including AI harnesses and sandboxing), and protect CI/CD pipelines against software supply chain risks.

  • Risk Registry Execution: Demonstrated ability to maintain a living risk registry, articulate risk trade-offs to non-technical executives, and rally engineering and commercial buy-in to remediate risks.

  • FinTech & Regulated SaaS Background: Multi-year leadership experience in a B2B SaaS, FinTech, or banking platform handling sensitive financial or transactional data under regulatory oversight (e.g., DORA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).

  • Technical Breadth: Strong practical understanding of AWS and GCP security primitives, container and Kubernetes security, modern IAM/SSO, API gateways, and EDR/XDR toolchains.

Bonus:

  • Industry certifications reflecting technical or managerial competence (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP, OSCP).

  • Direct experience securing real-time event-streaming architectures.

  • German language proficiency (conversational or fluent) is a strong advantage.

jobs.title: Principal, Revenue Marketing (International)
jobs.description:
Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data.

The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity.

Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control.

For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production.

Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide.

  • Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments.
  • Immuta has been recognized by Forbes as a top American startup employer, by Inc. Magazine and Built In as one of the best workplaces, and by Fast Company as one of the world’s most innovative companies.
  • Immuta has raised $263 million from investors including NightDragon, Snowflake, Databricks, ServiceNow, Citi Ventures, Dell Technologies Capital, DFJ Growth, IAG, Intel Capital, March Capital, Okta Ventures, StepStone, Ten Eleven Ventures, and Wipro Ventures.
  • We operate as a hybrid workplace with offices in Boston, MA; Columbus, OH; and College Park, MD.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Immuta’s marketing team sits at the intersection of data, AI, and enterprise growth. We turn a complex, important market problem into clear stories and meaningful connections with the people and organizations Immuta serves. We are building a thoughtful, modern marketing organization—one that values strong fundamentals, smart experimentation, useful data, and the judgment to know when a local insight should change the broader conversation.

This team brings Immuta’s global story to life in markets around the world. We work across cultures, customer needs, and market dynamics while staying connected to a shared purpose and a high standard of execution. For marketers who enjoy learning quickly, making sense of complexity, and helping a growing company earn trust in new markets, this is an opportunity to have visible impact with a genuinely global team.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As Principal, Revenue Marketing (International), you will help shape how Immuta shows up in markets beyond its home base. This individual contributer role offers unusual strategic latitude: you will bring together customer insight, commercial context, and a point of view on where the company can create the most value. You will have the opportunity to influence the way Immuta earns attention, builds credibility, and grows relationships across a diverse set of international audiences.

You’ll be part of a team that values clear thinking, thoughtful challenge, and momentum. The work will suit someone who enjoys navigating ambiguity, connecting people around a shared direction, and turning good ideas into progress. You will have visibility with senior partners across the business, the freedom to use your judgment, and the chance to help define how an ambitious data and AI company grows around the world.


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Set international marketing strategy, priorities, operating rhythms, and annual plans across priority markets.
  • Translate global go-to-market strategy into integrated regional programs spanning field, partner, digital, account-based, event, content, and campaign marketing.
  • Own international marketing contribution to target-account engagement, meeting creation, sourced pipeline, influenced pipeline, opportunity progression, and revenue growth.
  • Create repeatable AI-enabled workflows and scalable planning processes that improve the speed, quality, relevance, and efficiency of international marketing programs.
  • Partner with regional Sales and Alliances leaders to align on market priorities, account focus, campaign plans, follow-up motions, and performance expectations.
  • Develop partner-led growth through measurable co-marketing programs with strategic technology, cloud, channel, and ecosystem partners.
  • Localize global campaigns, messaging, content, and offers for local audiences while bringing market insight to Product Marketing, Content, Corporate Marketing, and other central teams.
  • Define performance metrics and reporting, analyze results by market and program, and improve investment decisions based on engagement, conversion, pipeline, and return.
  • Manage budgets, agencies, vendors, event investments, and partner resources against clear international priorities, while mentoring peers and raising the quality of work across Marketing.

    • REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
  • International Scope: B2B SaaS or enterprise technology marketing experience across multiple international markets, with ownership of strategy and outcomes.
  • Strategic Ownership: Experience setting international priorities, allocating resources, and delivering sourced or influenced pipeline, opportunities, revenue, account engagement, or market expansion.
  • AI Marketing: Hands-on use of generative AI and AI-powered tools for market intelligence, segmentation, localization, content, personalization, campaign optimization, or analytics; ability to turn experiments into repeatable workflows.
  • Integrated Marketing: Ownership across field, partner, demand, digital, events, content, and campaign marketing, balancing global consistency with local relevance.
  • Executive Influence: Ability to advise senior Sales, Alliances, Marketing, and business leaders; align stakeholders; and communicate recommendations and tradeoffs clearly.
  • Resource Management: Experience influencing international marketing investments and managing agencies, vendors, partners, event investments, or distributed resources.
  • Partner Marketing: Experience building joint go-to-market and measurable co-marketing programs with technology, cloud, channel, or ecosystem partners.
  • Analytics and Operations: Ability to define metrics, interpret funnel and pipeline data, build repeatable planning processes, improve execution, mentor peers, and lead without formal authority.
    • BENEFITS
     
    At Immuta, our goal is to help bridge the gap between personal and professional growth, so that our team members can be well and thrive personally and professionally. After all, great professional success stories rarely happen without great personal success stories! Our generous benefits package given to all full time employees includes:
    • 100% employer paid Healthcare (Medical, Dental, Vision) premiums for you and your dependents (including Domestic Partners)
    • Stock Options
    • Paid parental leave (Both Maternity and Paternity)

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
The Challenge 
Much of what Talk360 users see and touch is built with web technology - onboarding, buying credit, Shop360 and calling in the browser - on top of a Ruby on Rails platform. Every change you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of people in more than 190 countries, often on older devices, limited data plans and unreliable networks. For them, a checkout that won’t load isn’t a UX inconvenience. It’s a call home that doesn’t happen. 

Talk360 is profitable, our B2B2C platform is expanding, and we’re building an AI-first engineering team. We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with frontend as their home base: someone who builds excellent web experiences and is just as willing to go into our Rails backend to make them work end-to-end. 

What You'll Do 

Lead on frontend 

  • Build and improve our web experiences in React: onboarding, buying credit, Shop360 and account features 

  • Help evolve our web dialer and the web side of our embedded calling product, used by partners to bring Talk360 calling into their own platforms 

  • Shape frontend architecture and technical direction, working closely with the Tech Lead and the rest of the team 

  • Bring our design system to the web with consistent, accessible components across all our apps 

  • Own frontend quality: performance on low-end devices and slow networks, releases, monitoring and error tracking 

Work across the stack 

  • Take features end-to-end: build the Rails API and data model your frontend needs, instead of waiting for it 

  • Contribute to our Ruby on Rails platform, the backend behind our mobile apps, web apps and partner integrations 

  • Strengthen automated testing, CI/CD and tooling so we can ship often and with confidence 

  • Raise the level of the team through technical designs, code reviews and sharing what you know 

Learn from customers, build AI-first 

  • Ship features and experiments on the journeys that matter most to our users, from first open to buying credit 

  • Use data, error reports and user feedback to find and fix what hurts users most 

  • Work with Product and Design before implementation to shape solutions, not just execute them 

  • Use AI tooling throughout your workflow to raise quality and speed, and help shape how we work as an AI-first engineering team 

The Team 

You'll be working alongside Isah (Frontend), Oleg (Full Stack), Alex (Backend), Yahaya (VoIP and Data Platform), Igor (iOS and Mobile Lead), David (Android), and Tom (Tech Lead). The wider tech team you'll collaborate with includes Michal & Ali (QA). On the product side, you'll work closely with Quintin and Kseniia (Product) and Cameron (Design). 

Talk360 is a lean company, around 30 people globally, which means you'll interact regularly across functions: ops, support, data, and marketing. That cross-functional visibility is one of the things that makes the work here interesting and your impact visible. 


Tech Stack 

Must have 

  • React and TypeScript in production 

  • Modern HTML and CSS, responsive and mobile-first 

  • Web performance: making apps fast on low-end devices and slow networks 

  • Solid backend experience with Ruby on Rails: API design and relational databases (we use MySQL) 

  • Experience owning production applications end-to-end, from technical design to operations 

  • Experience implementing automated tests (unit, component and end-to-end) and working with CI/CD 

  • Git 

  • Actively using AI throughout your development workflow 

Nice to have 

  • Building or maintaining a design system or component library 

  • WebRTC, VoIP or real-time communication 

  • Payment and checkout flows 

  • Infrastructure experience: AWS (ECS, RDS), Docker, infrastructure as code 

  • Observability and analytics tooling (Sentry, Graylog, Mixpanel or similar) 

Who You Are 

  • You're a generalist with a frontend heart: you care about what users see and touch, and you'd rather own a problem end-to-end than stay in one layer of the stack. 

  • You naturally take ownership without waiting for permission. 

  • You enjoy solving hard technical problems while thinking about the bigger picture. 

  • You care deeply about software craftsmanship and user experience. 

  • You can explain the trade-offs behind your technical choices. 

  • You enjoy partnering with product teams and learning directly from customer feedback. 

  • You share what you know and help others improve and become stronger. 

  • You're pragmatic. You know when perfection matters and when shipping matters more. 

  • You're excited about building software that genuinely changes people's lives. 

  • You're based in or around Amsterdam and able to come to our office two to three times a week.

     

What You Get 

Competitive compensation 

  • 80,000 - 85,000 euros all-in gross annually

Learning and growth 

  • €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. 

Time to recharge 

  • 25 vacation days 

  • Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs 

  • Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we'll tell you more during the interview) 

Work from anywhere 

  • As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. 

A team you'll actually want to be part of 

  • Weekly team lunch every Thursday 

  • Regular team moments and outings 

  • An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond 

Set up for success 

  • Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work 

  • Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance 

An environment to grow and make impact 

  • A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission. 

About Talk360 

Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide. We've successfully spun off our payments business into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by Skype, and built a profitable, sustainable business.  We're now expanding beyond our own consumer app through our SDK, enabling partners to integrate Talk360's calling infrastructure directly into their own products. 

Our ambition is simple: To become the world's most trusted way to call any phone number. 

Here's what our users say: 

“I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.”  - Google Play, South Africa  ★★★★★ 

“Talk360 is a simple and reliable app for cheap international calls. It works even if the receiver has no internet, offers good call quality, and has transparent pricing.”  - Google Play, United States  ★★★★★ 

“It is a flawless experience with no hustles at all and the tariffs are more than just fair.”  - Trustpilot, United Kingdom  ★★★★★

jobs.title: Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role summary

We are expanding our Product Operations function to help our product organisation scale. As a Product Operations Manager, you will design processes, tools and data infrastructure that improve alignment between Product, Engineering and Go‑To‑Market teams. You will enable seamless collaboration, accelerate feedback loops and coordinate launches, reporting to Gianna Lengyel. The role is based in Paris with a global scope.

What you will do

  • Drive data and analytics – Ensure transparent reporting on customer engagements and product usage; work with Data Science to develop dashboards and insights for product decisions.

  • Manage feedback loops and discovery – Build structured processes to collect and analyse product feedback; run early access programmes and design partner tests.

  • Coordinate launches – Orchestrate product releases and enterprise launches, aligning product managers, marketers, engineers and legal teams.

  • Build product rituals – Shape planning, review and OKR routines; introduce tooling to streamline documentation and knowledge sharing.

  • Maintain product catalogue and documentation – Partner with technical writers to keep documentation current and accessible.

  • Standardise release cycles – Coordinate with Engineering and Science teams to manage release timelines and ensure reliability.

About you

  • 5+ years in product operations, product management or strategy/operations roles (e.g., chief of staff, consulting) in deep‑tech or AI environments.

  • Comfortable working with data and analytics; able to turn usage data and feedback into actionable insights.

  • Strong cross‑functional collaborator; experienced in aligning product, engineering, marketing and sales teams around shared priorities.

  • Process‑oriented mindset; skilled at building repeatable workflows and release processes.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

  • Fluency in English; French is a plus.

  • Bonus: experience with AI/ML products, pricing and packaging strategies, or consulting/finance backgrounds.

Hiring Process

Our recruitment process is designed to assess your fit for the role and give you a sense of our culture:

  1. Introduction call – 30 min

  2. Hiring manager interview – 30 min

  3. Interview with the product management team – 30 min

Location & Remote

The position is based in our Paris HQ offices and we encourage going to the office as much as we can (at least 3 days per week) to create bonds and smooth communication. Our remote policy aims to provide flexibility, improve work-life balance and increase productivity. Each manager can decide the amount of days worked remotely based on autonomy and a specific context (e.g. more flexibility can occur during summer). In any case, employees are expected to maintain regular communication with their teams and be available during core working hours.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Your Role

We are looking for a Data Engineer (f/m/d) at LIQID, who will play a key role in building and scaling data infrastructure that powers decision-making.

You will build scalable, high-performance data pipelines, ensure data integrity, and contribute to efficient data processing across the organization. Working closely with our Head of Data, Analytics Engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will help develop robust data architectures, enhance data security, and apply best practices that empower data-driven decision-making.

This is not a role where you preserve what already exists. It is a role where you help build what comes next. As LIQID scales beyond €4 billion in assets under management, the demands on our data infrastructure are growing fast. You will take real ownership of the pipelines you build, with room to propose solutions and the support to grow your scope.

 

What will keep you challenged?

  • Build, maintain, and optimize scalable data pipelines and storage solutions that ensure efficient, secure, and reliable data processing from source systems to our data warehouse

  • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT workflows to integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring seamless ingestion, transformation, and availability

  • Implement data quality, validation, and monitoring processes to guarantee accuracy and integrity for analytics and operational use cases

  • Ensure data security and compliance by applying best practices and industry standards for handling sensitive information

  • Collaborate with analysts, product managers, and engineers to understand data needs and deliver solutions that unlock new insights

  • Evaluate and propose new technologies to improve scalability, performance, and future-proof LIQID’s data infrastructure


What you bring

  • 3+ years of professional experience in data engineering or a similar data-related role (e.g., software or analytics engineering with a strong data focus)

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field

  • Solid proficiency in SQL, Python and ETL/ELT frameworks, with hands-on experience in data modelling, warehousing, and database management (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL)

  • Experience with at least one cloud data platform (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud) and modern data pipeline tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt)

  • Good understanding of data modelling principles and of data governance, security, and compliance best practices

  • FinTech experience is a plus, but a strong interest in financial services and data-driven decision-making is essential

  • Experience using AI coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to speed up development, with the judgment to verify output, not just ship it.

  • Familiarity with data quality testing frameworks or rules-as-code approaches (e.g. dbt tests, Great Expectations) to catch issues before they hit production is a plus.

  • Experience with streaming/near-real-time pipelines (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar) is a plus.

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken; German is a plus


What we offer

  • Diversity: Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one.

  • Flexibility: We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind.

  • Appreciation: You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas.

  • Development: We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget of €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display.

  • Smart Money: As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers.

  • Well-being: Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that.


What happens next

An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. The different stages help us understand how a potential collaboration could look.

  1. Initial Call with our Talent Partner: A casual introduction and discussion to align your expectations with the role.

  2. Video Interview with Head of Data: You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team.

  3. Technical Assessment with two Senior Team Members: A technical exchange to discuss your experience and expertise in relation to the role.

  4. In-Person Meeting: You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our CTO.
