jobs.title: Responsable De La Valorisation & Accompagnement Deeptech – Cdi
jobs.description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Au sein d’IMT Mines Albi, la Direction de la Recherche, du Doctorat, de l’Innovation et de l’Entrepreneuriat (DRDIE) définit et porte la stratégie scientifique, d’innovation et d’entrepreneuriat de l’école. Elle coordonne les moyens nécessaires à sa mise en œuvre, de la recherche amont à sa valorisation en innovations pour les filières industrielles, veille à leur adéquation avec les ambitions fixées et s’assure de la bonne exécution par les centres, qui contribuent à la dynamique collective.

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

En qualité de Responsable de la Valorisation & Accompagnement Deeptech, et sous la responsabilité du Directeur Adjoint Recherche, Doctorat, Innovation & Entrepreneuriat, vous portez l’offre de valorisation de technologies et d’entrepreneuriat deeptech de l’école. Vos principales missions consisteront à :

·         développer le portefeuille de technologies à valoriser issues des résultats de recherche des centres et des partenaires ;

·         convertir ces technologies en transferts vers des entreprises installées ou en création ;

·         promouvoir l’offre « valorisation de technologies & entrepreneuriat deeptech » ;

·         former et accompagner les personnels de recherche dans la conversion des résultats de recherche en innovations, les entrepreneurs dans leur projet de création d’entreprise technologique et les étudiants dans le domaine de l’innovation, dans le cadre de leur formation initiale.

Dans ce cadre, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

Développer le portefeuille de technologies à valoriser

·         structurer et piloter l’activité : analyse tactique, définition du process et des outils, actions opérationnelles, suivi de la performance, animation d’un réseau d’experts et mesure de la satisfaction ;

·         organiser et professionnaliser l’« Innovathon », dispositif de valorisation de la recherche à destination des filières industrielles, hybridé avec la formation à l’innovation et à l’entrepreneuriat ;

·         alimenter le catalogue de technologies à potentiel issues des centres et des partenaires de l’écosystème : construire le modèle, identifier et mobiliser les acteurs internes et externes, assurer le sourcing des résultats de la recherche, caractériser leur potentiel et proposer le mode de valorisation le plus pertinent.

Convertir ces technologies en transferts vers des entreprises installées ou en création

·         structurer et piloter cette activité de transfert selon la même démarche (process, outils, suivi de la performance, réseau d’experts, satisfaction) ;

·         développer les dispositifs de prospection auprès des clients industriels pour le transfert des technologies du portefeuille ;

·         identifier et activer les sources de financement utiles à l’activité ;

·         initier des projets de (pré)maturation de ces technologies, ou de transfert vers des candidats à la (pré)incubation et vers les industriels.

Promouvoir l’offre « valorisation de technologies & entrepreneuriat deeptech »

·         mobiliser les réseaux institutionnels, académiques et industriels afin de recruter des candidats aux parcours de (pré)incubation, de repérer des technologies à valoriser et d’identifier des prospects industriels ;

·         concevoir et organiser les événements annuels dédiés à la valorisation, à l’innovation et à l’entrepreneuriat ;

·         organiser les animations de l’« Espace Start-Up Territorial ».

Accompagner les personnels de recherche, selon leur maturité, dans la conversion des résultats de recherche en innovations

·         sensibiliser les personnels de recherche à la valorisation et à l’entrepreneuriat, avec une attention particulière pour les doctorants et post-doctorants ; coordonner les dispositifs internes dédiés ainsi que la participation aux dispositifs de l’écosystème ;

·         organiser, en coordination avec RED, un parcours valorisant et incitatif de sensibilisation, de formation et de détection dédié aux doctorants ;

·         identifier et « recruter » les chercheurs-valorisateurs (doctorants, personnels temporaires de recherche, personnels permanents) pour des projets de valorisation ou d’incubation ;

·         déployer des actions de mise en visibilité des chercheurs-valorisateurs.

Accompagner les entrepreneurs dans leur projet de création d’entreprise technologique

·         opérer l’un des deux parcours étudiant-entrepreneur du programme de pré-incubation et proposer des pistes d’amélioration ou de complément ;

·         accompagner les incubés, selon leur maturité, avec un focus fort sur la définition et la validation du besoin des cibles identifiées, de la proposition de valeur et du marché applicatif, sur le design fonctionnel de la solution et sur la consolidation de l’équipe porteuse du projet de création ;

·         les accompagner dans le montage de collaborations avec les centres et dans la recherche de financements.

Piloter le module de sensibilisation à l’innovation « Dynamiques d’innovation et entrepreneuriat » (IFIE1)

·         concevoir la maquette pédagogique et coordonner son déploiement ;

·         ancrer le module dans le continuum innovation & entrepreneuriat, dans une perspective de recrutement pour le parcours étudiant-entrepreneur.

 

Le poste nécessite des déplacements de courte durée, ainsi que l’organisation ou la participation à des événements en soirée.

 

CAPACITÉ ET ATTITUDES :

·         Vous disposez des compétences, connaissances et expériences suivantes :

o    maîtrise des approches et postures d’accompagnement dans le domaine de l’entrepreneuriat ;

o    approches structurantes de créativité et de conception innovante centrée utilisateurs ; approches de résolution de problèmes ;

o    méthodologies et outils de gestion de projets de recherche ou d’innovation ;

o    connaissance de l’écosystème institutionnel et académique de la recherche, de l’innovation et de la création d’entreprise ;

o    maîtrise des financements publics et privés dédiés à la valorisation de la recherche et à l’entrepreneuriat ;

o    maîtrise des processus de création et de développement d’une start-up, et bonne connaissance du processus de création d’une offre produit ; approche processus ;

o    capacité à déployer une approche d’accompagnement en entrepreneuriat, à commercialiser une offre B2B, à construire et développer un portefeuille de produits et à élaborer un plan de promotion de l’activité ;

o    capacité à déployer une méthode de créativité structurante, à analyser ou élaborer une roadmap produit et à mobiliser les réseaux ;

o    capacité à évaluer et hiérarchiser les besoins pour maîtriser la charge d’activité, et à gérer les aléas ;

o    aisance dans les échanges en anglais.

·         Les caractéristiques suivantes vous ressemblent :

o    organisation dans la conduite de votre activité et capacité à rendre compte de façon différenciée et adaptée à la situation ;

o    force de proposition et prise d’initiative ;

o    posture d’accompagnant adaptée au niveau de maturité du bénéficiaire ;

o    capacité de compréhension et d’influence d’écosystèmes complexes ;

o    aptitude à analyser des objets technologiques dans une perspective applicative, en réponse à un besoin utilisateur ;

o    adaptabilité aux différents interlocuteurs et situations dans un écosystème interculturel, politique et complexe ;

o    méthode, rigueur et fiabilité d’exécution.

 

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

·         Vous êtes titulaire d’un Master II et bénéficiez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans le domaine de la recherche et de l’innovation.[1]

 

AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? :

  • Un cadre de travail agréable sur un campus de 22 hectares ;

  • un forfait cadre avec 49 jours de congés annuels (congés + RTT) ;

  • le télétravail possible ;

  • une restauration administrative sur place ;

  • une aide à la mobilité durable pour les trajets domicile-travail ;

  • une action sociale (protection sociale complémentaire et aide aux familles) ;

  • une aide au déménagement ;

  • une aide à l’intégration sur le territoire : https://www.grand-albigeois.fr/entreprendre/creer-se-developper/soutien-au-recrutement-salarie/

 

 

INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES :

·       Nature et durée du contrat : CDI

·       Emploi ouvert aux titulaires de la fonction publique et aux personnes contractuelles

  • Fourchette de rémunération proposée de 31 700 € brut annuel à 37 600 € brut annuel, selon le profil.

    La rémunération est fixée selon le profil du candidat (métier, âge, filière d’emploi, durée de garantie salariale), en fonction des règles définies par le cadre de gestion de l’Institut Mines Télécom.

 

  • À usage interne :

    Catégorie du poste et métier de référence :  Catégorie II, Métier G – Cadre Administratif et de Gestion

  • Localisation du poste : IMT Mines Albi – Campus Jarlard, Route de Teillet, 81000 Albi

 

  • Date limite de candidature : 07/01/2027

  • Date des entretiens : 14/01/2027 après-midi

  • Date de prise de fonction souhaitée : au plus tôt

 

Les postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap

 

Contacts :

 

Sur le contenu du poste :

Sur les aspects administratifs/RH :

jobs.title: Leader, EMEA Product Support
jobs.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Leader, EMEA Product Support role manages Benchling support in EMEA. As the team leader (a player-coach role), you’ll manage Product Support Analalyts in Europe and spend roughly 40% of your time directly owning customer issues and our most complex escalations. This role owns live customer-impacting incidents for enterprise pharma and biotech customers, helps shape an AI-first support model, and sits close to CX leadership. Working closely with our Global Support and CX Leadership Teams, you’ll combine team leadership, incident management, and thoughtful AI adoption to help scale a modern, efficient Support organization. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and coach your team: run daily regional support operations including prioritization and resourcing, hold regular team meetings and career growth conversations, and build a culture where people feel supported and excited to grow.

  • Partner with the Incident Center of Excellence to mature the incident process (post-incident reviews, closing action items, communication playbooks, severity-based response criteria), and help build and run a sustainable off-hours coverage model, including personally rotating in as an escalation responder.

  • Analyze support metrics (volume, severity trends, time-to-resolution, comms timeliness) to inform staffing and process decisions, and report trends to CX leadership.

  • Drive consistent adoption of AI tools across support workflows, piloting ways to reduce ticket-handling time, surface account context automatically, and free up analyst time for higher-value work.

  • Collaborate with Build, Product, Technical Account Managers, Customer Success, and Professional Services on customer issues and incidents, keep help content and product knowledge current, and represent support at customer-facing events as needed.

  • Work the queue alongside your team: own complex, high-priority, and escalated tickets, serve as a first-line contact for regional escalations, and model the troubleshooting, investigation, and communication standards you expect from others.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experienced leader who coaches with empathy and stays close to the work, with 1+ years of management experience and 5+ years of SaaS support or professional services, or demonstrated leadership, including assigning ticket work and managing queues and resources. Able to personally troubleshoot and resolve complex customer issues.

  • Working knowledge of support and incident tooling and best practices for technical support environments (e.g. Salesforce, Zendesk, JIRA, PagerDuty, or equivalent), plus genuine enthusiasm for AI in support, ideally with hands-on experience piloting or driving adoption.

  • Sound judgment under pressure: prioritizing by urgency, severity, and customer health context, and skilled in customer-facing crisis communication, including what to say, when, and to whom during a live incident, and how to translate root cause into clear RCAs/ISNs.

  • Experience with enterprise-grade support: managing high-stakes accounts holistically, building trust with sophisticated customers, and thinking beyond individual ticket resolution.

  • Strong communicator and customer advocate with a bias toward action, comfortable working independently across departments, remote teams, and external stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences related field recommended (biology, microbiology, genetics, biotechnology, neurology, etc.); research or lab experience is a big plus.

  • Based in the Zurich area, or willing to relocate, and able to work on-site in our Zurich office Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.

     

HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About XYZ Reality


XYZ Reality created the world’s first engineering-grade augmented reality for construction. Our site-safe hardhat, The Atom, overlays the design model onto the live build, so our engineers can verify work as it goes in on some of the most complex mission-critical projects in the world.

Growing fast across the US, UK and Europe, we’re a driven, passionate team changing how the industry builds.

If you want your work to shape how the world gets built, we’d like to hear from you.

Help deliver the data centres powering the digital world

At XYZ Reality, we're transforming how some of the world's most complex construction projects are delivered. Combining engineering-grade augmented reality, BIM and project data, our technology gives construction teams the insight they need to make better decisions, improve accuracy and deliver with confidence.

We're looking for a Product Engineer who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering and customer experience. Someone who is as comfortable exploring a problem on a live construction site as they are building a prototype, interrogating data or contributing to a codebase.

THE ROLE

This isn't a traditional Product Manager or Software Engineer role. It's an opportunity to combine product thinking with hands-on technical execution, taking ownership of a defined area of our platform from discovery through to release.

You'll work closely with customers, engineers, designers and QA to identify meaningful problems, experiment with solutions and deliver products that have a measurable impact on construction teams.

You'll have the autonomy to shape product direction, challenge assumptions and turn ideas into working solutions, using data, code and AI-assisted development to accelerate learning and delivery.

Based in our London office, you'll also spend time on customer construction sites, gaining first-hand insight into the challenges our technology is helping to solve.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the product direction for a defined area of our platform, from discovery through to release, aligning priorities with customer and business outcomes.

  • Work directly with customers and site teams to understand their challenges and how AR, BIM and project data are used in real-world construction workflows.

  • Build functional prototypes and proofs of concept to test ideas, validate assumptions and accelerate product discovery.

  • Contribute directly to the codebase, leveraging AI-assisted development where it adds value.

  • Analyse project and usage data to inform product decisions, validate opportunities and measure impact.

  • Translate customer insights and technical findings into clear, evidence-based product requirements.

  • Collaborate with engineering, design and QA to shape solutions, evaluate technical approaches, make informed trade-offs and deliver high-quality releases.

  • Define and track product success metrics, using the results to determine what to build, improve or stop.

  • Communicate product decisions and their rationale clearly, bringing customers, technical teams and leadership together around a shared direction.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • A degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture or related discipline

  • Experience shipping and iterating B2B software products that customers rely on.

  • A track record of conducting customer discovery and translating insights into meaningful product improvements.

  • Hands-on technical capability, including the ability to read and write code and build functional prototypes.

  • A data-driven approach to product development, with the ability to define and measure product impact.

  • Practical experience using AI tools for prototyping, research, analysis and development, with sound judgement about where they add value.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Curiosity, initiative and a willingness to spend time with customers on live construction sites.

ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE WE'D LOVE TO SEE

  • A background in software engineering, data analytics or as a technical founder.

  • Experience building software for construction, engineering or field-based teams.

  • Familiarity with BIM, digital twins, 3D model data or model coordination tools.

  • Understanding of construction workflows, including commissioning, quality assurance or progress tracking.

  • Experience with AR, XR or spatial computing, particularly within enterprise or industrial environments.

  • Experience with SQL, APIs, data platforms or business intelligence tools.

You don't need to tick every box. We're interested in people who combine technical curiosity, product judgement and a genuine desire to solve complex customer problems.

WHY JOIN XYZ REALITY?

You'll have the opportunity to shape technology being used on some of the world's most complex construction projects, working at the intersection of augmented reality, engineering, data and AI.

You'll see the impact of what you build first-hand, working directly with the people who use our technology and helping shape the future of construction delivery.

BENEFITS

  • 🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays

  • 🎄 Additional Christmas shutdown days

  • 🩺 Private healthcare with Vitality

  • 🏠 Hybrid working

  • 🪙 Annual salary review

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Camunda's procurement function makes buying easy for every Camundi while keeping spend under control and compliant with finance, legal and security requirements. As Head of Procurement you lead the function, report directly to the CFO, and manage a Procurement Specialist and an external procurement contractor.

You own procurement at Camunda end to end: strategy, process, systems and the commercial outcome of our largest vendor relationships. This is a hands-on leadership role. You negotiate the big contracts yourself, set how we buy, and build a small, AI-first team that scales with the company.

What You Will Do:

  1. Own sourcing, contracting and purchasing company-wide: define the procurement operating model, policy (incl. escalations and exceptions) and SLAs, from intake to signed contract and PO.

  2. Lead negotiations for new purchases and renewals, with a focus on software and SaaS, cloud and AI tools, and professional services. Lead executive-level vendor negotiations personally.

  3. Drive spend reduction and tool consolidation with IT and budget owners; own the savings target, savings tracking and ROI before/after for major spend.

  4. Partner with FP&A on the annual budget and forecast: renewal calendar, committed spend, multi-year cost structure.

  5. Partner with IT and business stakeholders on proactive renewal planning and execution of software tools, managing with clear ownership and negotiation timelines

  6. Run supplier governance with Legal, InfoSec and Accounting: vendor risk, contract terms, DPAs, vendor master data and P2P controls (audit-ready); clarify ownership and exact responsibilities

  7. Own and improve our procurement stack (Zip for intake-to-PO, NetSuite, Brex, Ironclad for contracts) and establish and manage the operating model with external procurement partners. Use automation and AI to cut cycle times and manual work and partner with internal automation team to use our own process automation tool.

  8. Lead and develop the team (Procurement Specialist, external contractor): clear priorities, coaching, and a plan for how the function grow while also providing hands-on operational support, workload prioritization and capacity management

  9. Be the trusted advisor to the SLT and budget owners on sourcing strategy and vendor risk; report procurement KPIs (savings, cycle time, policy compliance, spend under management) to the CFO.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

  • 7+ years in procurement or strategic sourcing, ideally in a scaling B2B software / SaaS company, with at least 2 years leading people.

  • A track record of negotiating significant software and SaaS contracts and showing the savings.

  • Experience building procurement processes and policy from an early-stage base, and rolling out a procure-to-pay tooling

  • Commercial and financial acumen: you think in total cost of ownership, unit cost and budget impact, and you are comfortable with contract terms and vendor risk.

  • Strong stakeholder skills: you influence without authority, say no with a better alternative, and keep the process simple for requesters.

  • Hands-on with data and AI tools; you automate your own work.

  • Fluent English.

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency procurement (EU, US, UK, APAC).

  • Experience working with SaaS buying platforms or benchmarking partners (e.g. Vendr, Vertice).

jobs.description:
Deine nächste Projektperspektive mit New Monday

Wir sind New Monday und bringen erfahrene Spezialist in Kundenprojekte entlang des digitalen Produktentwicklungsprozesses. Unsere Wurzeln liegen im UX- und UI-Design. Diesen Fokus erweitern wir um Softwareentwicklung, Architektur, Cloud, Data und AI. So begleiten wir die Entwicklung digitaler Produkte ganzheitlich – von Websites und Apps bis hin zu komplexen Plattformen und Anwendungen.

Dabei verbinden wir fachliche Expertise mit einem klaren Verständnis für Nutzerbedürfnisse, technische Anforderungen und die Ziele unserer Kunden. Wir arbeiten remote und legen Wert auf Eigenverantwortung, offene Kommunikation und eine Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe.

Deine Aufgaben

Für ein langfristiges Kundenprojekt suchen wir einen Senior Azure Cloud DevOps Engineer (gn). Du entwickelst und betreibst skalierbare, sichere Azure-Cloud-Plattformen und modernisierst die Engineering- und Entwicklungstools internationaler Teams. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Automatisierung der Infrastruktur, der Weiterentwicklung von CI/CD-Pipelines und der Bereitstellung cloudnativer Services.

  • Du konzipierst, implementierst, administrierst und betreibst Azure-Cloud-Infrastrukturen und -Services.

  • Du automatisierst Infrastruktur und Deployments mit Terraform und OpenTofu und administrierst und optimierst Kubernetes-Plattformen.

  • Du entwickelst, pflegst und optimierst CI/CD-Pipelines und setzt GitOps-Konzepte mit FluxCD und ArgoCD um.

  • Du entwickelst C#/.NET-Anwendungen und Engineering-Tools, stellst sie bereit und integrierst und betreibst sie in der bestehenden Toollandschaft.

  • Du überwachst die Plattformen, analysierst und behebst Störungen, koordinierst Incidents und führst Root-Cause-Analysen durch.

  • Du optimierst die Performance der Cloud-Infrastruktur und unterstützt Cloud-Migrationen und Modernisierungsvorhaben.

  • Du setzt Cloud-Sicherheitskonzepte um und arbeitest im Identity- und Secrets-Management mit Keycloak und HashiCorp Vault.

  • Du arbeitest mit internationalen Entwicklungs- und Betriebsteams in einem agilen Umfeld zusammen.

Das bringst du mit

Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung

  • Azure Cloud Engineering, DevOps Engineering oder Platform Engineering

Mehr als 4 Jahre Erfahrung

  • C#, .NET Core und .NET Framework

  • Terraform und Infrastructure as Code

  • CI/CD und CI/CD-Pipelines

  • Cloud Computing, cloudbasierte Anwendungen und Docker-/Cloud-Technologien

  • Azure Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID

  • Windows-Administration

  • XML und YAML

  • Configuration Management

  • Softwareentwicklung, Anwendungsentwicklung und -wartung sowie Tools-/Prozesssoftware

  • Site Reliability Engineering oder Operations Engineering

Mehr als 3 Jahre Erfahrung

  • Betrieb von Azure-Cloud-Infrastrukturen

  • Verteilte Systeme und Netzwerke

  • Kubernetes

  • Troubleshooting und Debugging

  • .NET-Entwicklungs- und Deployment-Prozesse

  • Bash

Mehr als 2 Jahre Erfahrung

  • Linux-Administration

  • Unix Shells

  • Cybersecurity

  • Scripting, Automatisierung, Monitoring und Alerting

Weitere Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen

  • Kenntnisse in PowerShell und Python gemäß Skillmatrix (0–2 Jahre)

  • Erfahrung mit Git, DevOps-Prinzipien, cloudnativen Architekturen und agilen Entwicklungsmethoden

  • Erfahrung in internationalen Entwicklungsteams

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, des Software Engineerings, der Medizintechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative sowie Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit

Das erwartet dich bei New Monday

  • Flexibles Arbeiten passend zum Projekt: In diesem Projekt arbeitest du überwiegend remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Gelegentliche Teamtreffen finden vor Ort in Essen statt.

  • Flexibilität und Vertrauen: Du organisierst deine Arbeit eigenständig und stimmst dich dabei mit deinem Kundenteam ab. Bei New Monday setzen wir auf kurze Abstimmungswege und Vertrauen.

  • Aufgaben mit Wirkung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst deine Erfahrung direkt im Kundenprojekt ein und gestaltest digitale Prozesse mit, die den Netzausbau und die Integration von Erzeugungsanlagen unterstützen.

  • Persönliche Begleitung im Projekteinsatz: Auch wenn dein Arbeitsalltag überwiegend im Kundenteam stattfindet, bleiben wir mit dir im Austausch und begleiten dich bei Fragen, Herausforderungen und deiner Entwicklung.

  • Ein Team, das sich auch persönlich trifft: Neben dem digitalen Austausch schaffen wir bewusst Raum für regionale Treffen und gemeinsames Coworking. Ein- bis zweimal im Jahr kommt das gesamte New-Monday-Team zusammen.

  • Zeit und Budget für deine Entwicklung: Wir fördern fachliche Weiterbildung und den Austausch im Team. Nach der Probezeit steht dir dafür ein Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 € zur Verfügung.

  • Entwicklung mit Perspektive: Wir arbeiten aktuell an einem Karriereentwicklungsplan, der Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und nächste Schritte bei New Monday transparenter machen soll. Deine eigenen Ziele und Interessen besprechen wir regelmäßig mit dir.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub und zusätzlich zwei Tage für unsere Team-Events.

Dein Weg zu uns

Du fühlst dich angesprochen und erfüllst einzelne Anforderungen für dieses Projekt (noch) nicht? Melde dich trotzdem gern bei uns. Wenn dein Profil grundsätzlich zu unseren Kundenprojekten passt, nehmen wir dich gerne in unseren Bewerberpool auf und kommen bei einer passenden Projektanfrage auf dich zu.

Bei einem passenden Projekt wirst du bei New Monday zunächst für 1 Jahr festangestellt und bringst dann deine Expertise beim Kunden ein. Arbeitsort, Remote-Anteil und weitere Rahmenbedingungen stimmen wir passend zum jeweiligen Projekteinsatz gemeinsam mit dir ab.

Zum Kennenlernen freuen wir uns auf deinen aktuellen Lebenslauf, aussagekräftige Projektbeschreibungen oder vergleichbare Arbeitsnachweise. Teile uns außerdem deine Verfügbarkeit beziehungsweise Kündigungsfrist und deine Gehaltsvorstellung als Bruttojahresgehalt mit. So können wir bei passenden Projektanfragen gezielt auf dich zukommen.

New Monday fördert die Gleichstellung aller Beschäftigten. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität. jobs.description:
What we’re all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

Want to help defence and national security organisations see the risk hidden in their supply chains, their suppliers, their people and the threats they track? We're looking for an EMEA lead for our National Security and Defence solutions. You'll build this sub-industry for Quantexa with the UK and allied defence and national security markets worldwide, set its direction and take it to market with our partners.

Defence ministries, armed forces, intelligence agencies and homeland security bodies hold supplier, personnel and intelligence data in separate, often classified systems. Hidden foreign ownership behind a supplier, a dual-use export, procurement fraud, a gap in a vetting record, a sanctions or proliferation network, or a sign of hostile state activity is easy to miss.

That's the problem we solve. We connect that data into resolved entities and networks – who owns, supplies, funds and works for whom – so analysts can see the connections that matter, across supply chain risk, personnel vetting, counter-proliferation and intelligence analysis. People make the decisions; we give them the full picture. We deliver in defence and national security with security-cleared partners and system integrators.

You'd lead this from our Product team, which sits where the market meets the product. You'll report to our VP Government Solutions. Complex problems, senior audiences, real public impact. Ready?

What you'll be doing.

  • Own the National Security and Defence proposition across EMEA – the positioning, the messaging and the organisations we go after – and turn what you hear in the market into requirements that shape our EMEA roadmap.

  • Make sure it works – keep one set of National Security and Defence decks, demos, blueprints and playbooks in line with the released product.

  • Be our senior expert worldwide – support Sales and Field Engineering on the opportunities that matter, as a trusted advisor to senior government stakeholders.

  • Build our voice in the market – thought leadership, industry events, analyst briefings and client roundtables.

  • Team up with Marketing and Sales – on campaigns, competitor analysis, business cases and the enablement that helps our teams and partners sell with confidence.

  • Work with defence primes and system integrators – the partners who deliver our defence and national security work – on joint propositions, pitches and enablement, within our policies on where and with whom we work in defence and national security.

  • Bring the field back into Product – decide which field work becomes product, and work with R&D to keep the solution ahead.

What success looks like.

In your first 6 months:

  • National Security and Defence proposition, messaging and priority organisations (defence, intelligence and homeland security) agreed for each region and in use by Sales and Field Engineering.

  • One current set of National Security and Defence material that matches the released product.

  • The partners we take the National Security and Defence proposition to market with agreed, and each one enabled.

By 12 months:

  • A measurable contribution to National Security and Defence pipeline and wins across EMEA.

  • A recognised voice in the market, with [n] customer or partner proof points we can use.

  • Field Engineering and our main partners able to sell and demo the National Security and Defence solutions without you.

What you'll bring.

You have deep expertise in defence or national security, ideally in supply chain risk, security vetting, counter-proliferation or intelligence analysis. Don't tick every box below? If you recognise yourself in most of it, we'd still like to hear from you.

  • Real depth in defence or national security. You have built or run supply chain risk, security vetting, counter-proliferation or intelligence analysis systems or strategies, inside a defence ministry, the armed forces, an intelligence or homeland security agency, at a prime or system integrator, or advising one. Credible with analysts. Credible with senior officers and officials.

  • A voice the market listens to. You present and write well, and you can hold a room of experienced stakeholders, from analysts to agency executives.

  • Strategy, and sleeves rolled up. You'll set the direction – then happily build the business case, the demo or the deck yourself.

  • Curiosity about the tech. You'll learn our platform properly, so you can say what it does and where it's genuinely different.

  • You choose well where to spend your time, and bring colleagues, partners and clients with you.

  • Able to obtain and keep local security clearance (eg: UK: SC or DV).

Nice to have.

  • French, Dutch or German.

  • Experience of defence procurement, export controls, sanctions or counter-proliferation.

  • Hands-on experience with technologies such as Spark, Scala, Elastic or Python.

  • Experience across several international defence and national security markets, or extra languages.

Location.

This role is based in London, with regular international travel to customers, partners and our other offices.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organisation. You'll run the complex analysis and modelling behind target setting and annual planning for the entire commercial organisation. You will also help the Director set and execute the revenue analytics strategy, and run the insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business. As you ramp up, you will take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations.

We are looking for someone with very strong analytical and modelling skills, which are the foundation of the role, especially in your first two quarters. Just as important, we want someone who is commercially minded and keen to grow into a generalist role, broadening from there into revenue insights and forecasting.


What You’ll Do

  • First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards.

  • First 180 days: Lead the analysis for the annual planning and target-setting cycle, and automate the core of revenue reporting and insights with AI tooling.

  • First 12 months: Take on co-ownership of the forecasting cadence with the Director of Revenue Operations.

 

What Will You Be Doing?

Run Complex Modelling & Analysis

  • Run complex analysis and modelling to support target setting and the annual planning process for the entire commercial organisation, made up of around 600 commercial roles across SDRs, AEs and Account Managers.

  • Build and maintain the models behind target setting: capacity, quota and productivity assumptions, and territory and segment allocation.

  • Frame the key planning questions, choose the method, pressure-test scenarios and sensitivities, and deliver clear recommendations to revenue leadership, explaining the trade-offs in plain language.

  • Work as the senior analytical partner to the other analyst on the team: stay hands-on in the models while setting the quality bar and documentation standards, so each planning cycle is repeatable and auditable.

Build the Revenue Analytics Strategy

  • Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the revenue analytics strategy: what we need to build across Salesforce and Looker, and in what order.

  • Map the current reporting landscape — what exists, what's trusted, what's duplicated or out of date — and use that map to shape the build plan.

  • Own execution of that plan: build and maintain the core dashboards and reports that revenue leadership and the wider commercial organisation rely on.

  • Launch and run a recurring insights digest for revenue leaders, turning dashboards and data into a clear narrative — what changed, why it matters, what to do about it.

  • Bring a point of view on what's worth building versus what's noise, and be willing to push back on requests that don't earn their keep.

Grow Into Forecasting

  • Co-run the forecasting cadence with sales leaders and the Director of Revenue Operations — forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and accuracy tracking.

  • Build and refine forecasting models based on pipeline, productivity, and historical conversion.

  • Conduct strategic analyses to determine forecasting trends and identify opportunities for process improvement.


What You’ll Bring

  • Strong experience in Revenue or Sales Operations, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level.

  • Advanced modelling and scenario analysis skills (spreadsheets and SQL), ideally with experience in target setting, capacity planning or annual planning for a large commercial organisation.

  • Solid Salesforce reporting skills and working fluency in a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), with a practical, business-first approach to data.

  • Commercial judgement and exposure to quota-carrying teams such as Account Executives, plus a generalist mindset: as comfortable building a dashboard as a planning model or running a forecasting call.

  • The ability to influence sales leadership and revenue executives, and to own ambiguous problems end to end, from framing the question to landing the recommendation.

  • Excellent written communication, since the insights digest is a core, ongoing deliverable of this role.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate analysis and reporting, or a clear appetite to build that skill quickly.


What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Context

 

Are you passionate about building immersive 3D experiences and pushing the limits of what’s possible with Unity? We’re looking for a Unity Software Engineer to help us shape the future of LiDAR simulation.

Your work will drive the creation of scalable, high-performance, and intuitive solutions that empower our users and bring complex technology to life.

Contribute to the functional and technical evolutions of the simulator.

Synchronize with different teams including R&D, 3D artists and engineers.

Prioritize and schedule the releases of bug fixes and features.

Optimize the performance of our simulator with the help of Unity’s profiler tools.

Design and restructure the code base.

Develop dynamic simulation tools for model training and live demos.

Continue the development of a realistic crowd simulation to navigate 3D environments.

 

Requirements for the Role

 

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Game Development, or related field.

Experience: 4-5 years working with Unity on professional projects (3D software, simulations, or games).

Strong knowledge of Unity and C# programming.

System and architecture design

Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn new technologies.

Be part of the team pioneering Spatial Intelligence solutions at unprecedented scale—the breakthrough technology transforming how the world’s most prestigious airports, infrastructure operators, and smart cities understand and optimize physical flows.

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organisation. You'll run the complex analysis and modelling behind target setting and annual planning for the entire commercial organisation. You will also help the Director set and execute the revenue analytics strategy, and run the insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business. As you ramp up, you will take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations.

We are looking for someone with very strong analytical and modelling skills, which are the foundation of the role, especially in your first two quarters. Just as important, we want someone who is commercially minded and keen to grow into a generalist role, broadening from there into revenue insights and forecasting.


What You’ll Do

  • First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards.

  • First 180 days: Lead the analysis for the annual planning and target-setting cycle, and automate the core of revenue reporting and insights with AI tooling.

  • First 12 months: Take on co-ownership of the forecasting cadence with the Director of Revenue Operations.

 

What Will You Be Doing?

Run Complex Modelling & Analysis

  • Run complex analysis and modelling to support target setting and the annual planning process for the entire commercial organisation, made up of around 600 commercial roles across SDRs, AEs and Account Managers.

  • Build and maintain the models behind target setting: capacity, quota and productivity assumptions, and territory and segment allocation.

  • Frame the key planning questions, choose the method, pressure-test scenarios and sensitivities, and deliver clear recommendations to revenue leadership, explaining the trade-offs in plain language.

  • Work as the senior analytical partner to the other analyst on the team: stay hands-on in the models while setting the quality bar and documentation standards, so each planning cycle is repeatable and auditable.

Build the Revenue Analytics Strategy

  • Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the revenue analytics strategy: what we need to build across Salesforce and Looker, and in what order.

  • Map the current reporting landscape — what exists, what's trusted, what's duplicated or out of date — and use that map to shape the build plan.

  • Own execution of that plan: build and maintain the core dashboards and reports that revenue leadership and the wider commercial organisation rely on.

  • Launch and run a recurring insights digest for revenue leaders, turning dashboards and data into a clear narrative — what changed, why it matters, what to do about it.

  • Bring a point of view on what's worth building versus what's noise, and be willing to push back on requests that don't earn their keep.

Grow Into Forecasting

  • Co-run the forecasting cadence with sales leaders and the Director of Revenue Operations — forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and accuracy tracking.

  • Build and refine forecasting models based on pipeline, productivity, and historical conversion.

  • Conduct strategic analyses to determine forecasting trends and identify opportunities for process improvement.


What You’ll Bring

  • Strong experience in Revenue or Sales Operations, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level.

  • Advanced modelling and scenario analysis skills (spreadsheets and SQL), ideally with experience in target setting, capacity planning or annual planning for a large commercial organisation.

  • Solid Salesforce reporting skills and working fluency in a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), with a practical, business-first approach to data.

  • Commercial judgement and exposure to quota-carrying teams such as Account Executives, plus a generalist mindset: as comfortable building a dashboard as a planning model or running a forecasting call.

  • The ability to influence sales leadership and revenue executives, and to own ambiguous problems end to end, from framing the question to landing the recommendation.

  • Excellent written communication, since the insights digest is a core, ongoing deliverable of this role.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate analysis and reporting, or a clear appetite to build that skill quickly.


What We Offer

  • 25 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • An optional pension scheme to support your long-term financial wellbeing.

  • A tax-efficient bike leasing scheme through Lease a Bike, for your commute or personal use.

  • Reimbursed commuting costs if you live more than 10km away from the office.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Video Editor at AIOS — Remote, $1,500-$2,000/month (contract)
jobs.description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving 200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

The opportunity as Video Editor at AIOS

We are building a world-class team.

As Video Editor at AIOS, your fundamental role is to turn sharp creative briefs into scroll-stopping ads, fast, so our best ideas hit the market while they're still fresh.

You're an AI-native editor. Tools like Higgsfield are part of your editing suite: you orchestrate AI-generated clips, voiceover, captions and sound into polished direct-response ads, and you only cut by hand where the machine falls short.

You work straight from our strategists' briefs: a reference ad, a visual hook direction, a script and the nuances that make it land. You execute precisely, turn concepts around in 24–48 hours and handle revisions the same day. You know what a winning DR ad looks like, from the first three seconds through to the CTA.

You'll work across our brands in the UK and US, starting with our UK launch, and across formats: UGC-style, talking head with b-roll, AI-generated video, animation and whatever's working next.

You'll:

  • ship multiple finished ad concepts every week

  • spin out hook variations and format iterations on our winning ads

  • build AI editing workflows the rest of the editor pool can use

  • keep quality high at volume: clean captions, synced sound, no visible AI artifacts

Great performance in this role means our strategists never wait on production, and every winner gets iterated before it fatigues.

This is a full-time, fully remote contract role, and you’ll work async, ideally on US Eastern Time hours so brief handoffs and same-day revisions move fast.

You’ll report directly to our Head of Growth, David Charles.

You’ll also work most closely with:

  • Jake Antifaev

  • our creative strategists

Key Responsibilities

  • Brief to finished ad: You turn strategist briefs into finished direct-response ads, following the reference, hook direction and script precisely. Every brief has nuances that matter, and you catch them.

  • AI production: You generate and assemble AI video assets with tools like Higgsfield, then finish them with captions, music, sound effects and text overlays. Most of your time goes into orchestrating AI, not cutting frame by frame.

  • Iterations on winners: You produce hook variations and format iterations on ads that are already working, so proven concepts keep compounding.

  • Speed: You deliver multiple concepts a week on 24–48 hour turnarounds and turn revisions around the same day.

  • Platform-ready exports: You export in the right aspect ratios and specs for Meta, TikTok and other placements, every time.

  • Quality at volume: Captions are spelled right, music is synced, transitions are clean and AI artifacts are minimised. You check your own work before anyone else has to.

  • Workflow building: You document the prompts, templates and workflows that work, so the editor pool gets faster as it grows.

Need to Have

  • Proven DR ad work: You've edited ecommerce or DTC ads that actually ran on Meta or TikTok, and you can show them. A general video portfolio isn't enough.

  • AI-native: You use AI video tools (e.g. Higgsfield) every day. You know how to prompt, generate and integrate the outputs into a final edit.

  • DR structure: You understand hook, body and CTA, and you know why the first three seconds matter more than anything else.

  • Animation + multi-format: You've made Pixar-style, cartoon or claymation-style ads that performed, and you're just as strong across other formats: UGC-style, talking head with b-roll and AI-generated video.

  • Fast turnaround: You can deliver a polished concept within 24–48 hours and turn revisions around the same day.

  • Brief execution: You follow detailed briefs precisely without needing to be walked through them.

  • Attention to detail: Captions, sync, transitions and AI artifacts are clean before you hand anything over.

  • Reliable: You hit every deadline without being chased.

  • Clear written English: You communicate clearly and quickly on Slack.


‼️

NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF: you can't show ads you edited that ran on Meta or TikTok, or you'd rather craft slow, polished brand films than ship a high volume of direct-response tests.

Nice to Have

  • Cracked AI workflow: You've built an AI editing workflow that lets you ship far more than a traditional editor, and you can walk us through it.

  • Hard-core DR brands: You've edited for DR brands that broke out recently (e.g. Resilia, Bioroot Labs, Elare) and know what's working right now.

  • Trust-building categories: Health, supplements, telehealth or other categories where trust carries the sale.

  • Strategist instincts: You can suggest a sharper hook or a better cut, not just execute the brief.

  • Lead editor potential: You've QA'd or led other editors' work and could step up to lead editor as the pool grows.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2030 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


    🎯

"You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

  • Compensation: $1,500–$2,000/month, contractor. Paid per brief during a first-month trial, then the monthly rate.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate)

  • Vacation: PTO with a yearly minimum (≥2wks/yr + local national holidays)

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching ($1200/yr)

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps ($1200/yr)

  • Coaching: free biweekly health coaching

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

It is a full hands-on, build-from-scratch role: for the first 12–18 months you will operate largely on your own, performing and leading the audits yourself, with the support of Nubank's global Internal Audit team and additional resources over time as the function matures. You'll report functionally into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership, preserving Internal Audit's independence and maintaining direct access to the entity's Audit and Risk Committees.

You will build a modern, data-driven audit function — one that leans on automation, analytics and AI rather than traditional checklist auditing — while partnering with a young, fast-scaling business where governance and controls are still being built. Your goal: stand up and run a credible Internal Audit function that gives the Committees and the local regulator confidence that Nubank is growing in a healthy, sustainable way.

You'll be responsible for

  • Acting as the statutory Head of Internal Audit for the European entity, representing Internal Audit before the local regulator and reporting independently into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership and the relevant Committees.

  • Owning the entity's Internal Audit universe and risk assessment — a dynamic view of key risks across products, digital asset initiatives, financial crime, governance and internal-control frameworks.

  • Designing and executing the audit plan, and coordinating closely with Nubank's global Internal Audit function and the hubs in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia.

  • Performing and leading end-to-end audits hands-on — not only scoping and coordinating fieldwork, but often running the testing yourself — covering fintech/digital banking products, digital assets and related infrastructure, AML/financial-crime obligations, and governance, risk and control frameworks.

  • Coordinating Internal Audit's contribution to supervisory interactions with the local regulator, being comfortable explaining clearly what Internal Audit does before any regulator, and proactively communicating emerging risks.

  • Engaging the governance bodies — Audit Committee and Risk Committee — with clear, concise, impact-oriented reporting.

  • Building trust-based relationships with local senior management and second-line risk/compliance partners, operating as a trusted challenger and advisor while preserving Internal Audit's independence.

  • Promoting the use of technology, data and AI in the audit work — continuous auditing routines, data analytics, AI-assisted testing and documentation — to increase coverage and enable predictive risk monitoring.

  • Acting as a culture carrier for Nubank's Internal Audit, keeping the local function fully integrated into the global audit vision and standards.

  • Over time, and consistent with business and regulatory needs, designing, building and leading an appropriately resourced Internal Audit function for the entity.

We are looking for a person who has

Experience and background

  • A solid Internal Audit background in financial services (as an internal or external auditor); senior second-line/compliance profiles are welcome when grounded in prior Internal Audit experience.

  • Experience with the Swiss or European regulatory framework.

  • Meaningful experience in fintech or banking.

  • Experience engaging governance bodies, specifically Audit and Risk Committees.

  • Proven knowledge of fintech/digital-banking business models, AML/financial-crime controls and investigations, and traditional banking products and infrastructure.

Ways of working and skills

  • High ownership and autonomy

  • A genuinely hands-on posture

  • A builder mindset

  • A data-driven approach to audit: experience with data and analytics in audit or risk work; hands-on SQL/Python is a strong plus and a good signal of fit, and a strong appetite to work with data-driven testing is essential.

Cultural openness and humility

  • Ability to analyze end-to-end processes and controls across finance, credit, payments, AML, information security, technology and governance, connecting the details to the overall risk profile.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, explaining complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including regulators and senior executives.

  • Strong stakeholder management — influencing senior leaders, challenging constructively and building trust across the three lines of defense.

  • German is required — the local regulator operates in German and there is no intermediary for regulatory interaction, so working proficiency in German is needed. Fluent English is also required.

Nice to have

  • Experience with digital assets — crypto and stablecoins. (Digital-assets experience is a plus, not a requirement)

  • No specific certification is required (CIA, ACCA, CISA, etc. are welcome but not mandatory).

Location for this opportunity

jobs.description:
About the role

At SkyNRG, we’re on a mission leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high‑integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF). As a Strategy Intern, you will support the Strategy team in shaping and executing key strategic initiatives across the business.

During this internship, you will work closely with experienced strategy professionals and collaborate with stakeholders across development, commercial, and corporate teams. You will contribute to strategic analyses, support business planning cycles, and help drive initiatives that improve how the company operates. This role offers exposure to corporate strategy, commercial strategy, and business improvement initiatives in a purpose-driven organization.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Strategy support: Assist in developing and refining corporate and commercial strategies.

  • Market & business analysis: Conduct market research, competitive analyses, and business case assessments.

  • Commercial strategy projects: Support projects focused on areas such as sourcing, product development, partnerships, and market expansion.

  • Data analysis: Assist in building financial models, analyzing commercial performance, and supporting data-driven insights.

  • Workshops & stakeholder alignment: Help prepare materials for strategic discussions, workshops, and presentations for internal stakeholders and leadership.

  • Business improvement initiatives: Support projects aimed at improving processes, frameworks, and internal ways of working.

Your profile

You recognize yourself in the following:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s student in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Strategy, Sustainability, Energy, or a related field (enrolled for the full duration of the internship)

  • Strong interest in strategy, consulting, and business improvement

  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail

  • Comfortable working with Excel and PowerPoint; experience with financial modelling or data analysis is a plus

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills

  • Proactive, structured, and able to manage multiple topics simultaneously

  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work with diverse stakeholders

  • Professional level of English, both written and spoken

  • Full-time availability for a 6-month internship from 15th of February 2027 onwards

  • Strong interest in our company, energy transition and building a more sustainable aviation industry

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

  • An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

  • Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

  • A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

  • A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

What we offer

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

Besides that, we offer:

  • A unique working experience in a scale-up at the forefront of sustainable aviation.

  • An inspiring international work environment in a fast growing and innovative industry.

  • A great opportunity to work in a multidisciplinary, committed, and talented team.

  • A monthly internship allowance of 800 euros.

  • Commuting travel reimbursement.

  • Free Daily Lunch

  • Paid Volunteering Day.

  • Access to our electric company boat and social activities – all part of the deal!

Is this you?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying.

For more information about SkyNRG visit www.skynrg.com.
