jobs.title: Working Student MDR
jobs.description:
About the Role

Every month, hundreds of potential customers show interest in Trengo. They start a free trial, request a demo, or leave their contact details. But not everyone gets the personal follow-up they need to take the next step.

That's where you come in.

As our Marketing Development Representative (MDR), you'll be the first personal point of contact for potential customers, helping them find the right way to get started with Trengo.

You'll join our Growth Marketing team and work closely with Sales, sitting right at the intersection of marketing and sales. You'll turn the demand we generate into real business opportunities, whether that's booking a meeting with an Account Executive or helping someone become a paying customer through our self-serve journey.

This is a hands-on junior role where you'll get to learn how a fast-moving AI SaaS company turns marketing efforts into revenue, with plenty of room to experiment, develop your skills, and make a measurable impact.

It's an 8-month contract with the possibility of extension.

About Trengo

Welcome to the forefront of AI-driven communication. At Trengo, we’re redefining the industry by replacing repetitive work with meaningful conversations through our AI-powered customer engagement platform. We unify communication channels and leverage agentic AI to deliver proactive, human-like service, boosting efficiency for thousands of businesses worldwide.

As a fast-moving Dutch scale-up, backed by a $36M Series A and an official WhatsApp Business Solutions Provider, we thrive on acceleration. Your expertise will drive growth: you’ll make a strategic impact, champion AI innovation, and help shape the product roadmap. You’ll do this alongside an international team guided by our Dynamic pace, Future-proof mindset, Ownership, and Open culture.

What your role looks like:

Turn inbound interest into opportunities

  • Be the first personal point of contact for new inbound leads, reaching out through calls and personalised emails, ideally within the same working day.

  • Follow up with qualified free-trial sign-ups, demo requests and prospects who have expressed interest but haven't booked a meeting.

  • Re-engage prospects whose meetings weren't booked, were cancelled or resulted in a no-show, and help them take the next step.

  • Connect qualified prospects with the right Account Executive, making sure they have the context needed for a productive conversation.

Help prospects become self-serve customers

  • Reach out to prospects who might not be the right fit for a sales conversation but could still benefit from Trengo.

  • Understand what they're looking for, answer initial questions and guide them towards the right self-serve plan.

  • Follow up with free-trial users to help them get started and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers.

Improve how we engage with leads

  • Experiment with different outreach messages, sequences and follow-up approaches to understand what converts best.

  • Share insights with Marketing and Sales about common objections, lead quality and what prospects are looking for.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate and up to date by logging interactions, tracking outcomes and maintaining clean lead data.

How we'll measure success

You'll have a direct impact on our growth, with clear results you can track:

  • Speed of follow-up: Making sure inbound prospects receive timely, personal attention.

  • Meetings generated: Booking qualified meetings that turn into conversations with our Account Executives.

  • Self-serve conversions: Helping prospects progress from initial interest to becoming paying customers.

  • Continuous improvement: Finding better ways to engage prospects and sharing insights that help our Marketing and Sales teams improve.

The tools you'll work with

You'll get hands-on experience with our commercial and AI toolkit:

  • HubSpot: CRM, lead management, outreach sequences and calling.

  • RevenueHero: Lead routing and meeting booking.

  • Fathom: Call recordings, feedback and coaching.

  • Slack & Notion: Team collaboration, processes and playbooks.

  • AI tools: Researching prospects, personalising outreach and experimenting with smarter ways of working.

What you’ll bring

  • 1-2 years of experience, ideally through an internship or an early-career role in sales, marketing, customer success or a customer-facing environment.

  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. Dutch is a big plus.

  • Confidence in communication: You're comfortable picking up the phone, writing personalised emails and starting conversations with people you haven't met.

  • A proactive mindset: You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You spot opportunities and take initiative.

  • An organised way of working: You can manage multiple conversations, prioritise your day and follow through on commitments.

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn: You're interested in SaaS, AI and how businesses grow, and you're open to coaching and feedback.

  • A results-driven attitude: You enjoy working towards clear goals, experimenting with different approaches and understanding what works.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with HubSpot or other CRM tools.

  • Exposure to inbound lead follow-up, prospecting or sales processes.

  • Additional language skills such as Dutch, German, French, Spanish or Italian.

  • Familiarity with eCommerce, WhatsApp Business or customer communication platforms.

  • Experience using AI tools to research prospects, personalise communication or improve workflows.

⚙️ Our tech & AI mindset

AI is not a buzzword at Trengo — it’s part of how we build and operate. You’ll work with AI-driven features, automation, data, or tools that help us move faster and smarter. We value thoughtful use of AI that creates real value for customers and teams.

What’s in it for you?

This is what we carefully prepared for you:

  • 🚀 A key role where you’ll make a visible impact in a vibrant scale-up environment.

  • 🌍 Hybrid working + 2 months per year to work abroad.

  • 🏗️ A strong onboarding program with hands-on training and a dedicated buddy to set you up for success.

  • 🧘 Mental health support with free sessions from on-demand psychologists (OpenUp).

  • 📚 Learning budget + 2 extra days off to attend courses or conferences.

  • 🌴 28 vacation days to rest, recharge, and travel

  • 🚆 Travel reimbursement to our Utrecht HQ.

  • 📶 Monthly internet & phone allowance to stay connected.

  • 🗣️ Dutch courses for our international colleagues.

  • 🍴 Daily warm lunches prepared by our workplace experience team when you’re at our beautiful Utrecht office.

  • 💼 Pension contribution to help you plan for the future.

  • 🛫 Sabbatical: After two years, enjoy up to three months away (unpaid) to rest, recharge, or see the world.

🔍 Our hiring process

  1. Introductory call – First conversation with our Talent team.

  2. Manager interview – Deep dive into experience and expectations.

  3. Practical assignment – Role-related, real-world challenge.

  4. Team connection – Meet future colleagues and confirm mutual fit.

We aim to keep the process clear, fair, and timely, and we’ll keep you informed at every step.

Your next challenge starts here!

Join us in building the future of customer engagement — we’d love to have you on the team.

👉 Apply today and let’s grow together!

We believe great ideas come from diverse perspectives. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.description:
Important Information

This role is a full time, 100% in office, entry-level position. No experience is required.

Working hours: M-F, 10AM - 6:30PM

Location: Oude Meer, North Holland, 1438 BC

Contract: 6 month FTC

About Nivoda

Nivoda is the leading global B2B jewellery marketplace, Nivoda’s growth trajectory has skyrocketed over the past 12 months, and we continue to expand across new regions at an unprecedented pace. Our DNA centers on understanding our customers' needs and offering them a seamless experience. With a growing team based in major cities worldwide, including London, New York, Hong Kong, and Mumbai, Nivoda is becoming the go-to marketplace for the global jewelry industry.

We aim to be bold, innovative, and relentless in our pursuit of excellence as we transform an industry steeped in tradition.

The Role

You'll be a key player in a tight-knit team. Working alongside highly experienced logistics professionals at one of our largest international hubs, you'll handle and repack incoming and outgoing diamond shipments with precision and care.

This is a hands-on, detail-oriented role that sits at the heart of our operations. You’ll be responsible for maintaining the smooth day-to-day flow of the office while upholding our high standards of accuracy and security. With our rapidly growing company, the opportunities for personal and professional growth are enormous.

If you're looking for a fast-paced, highly supportive environment where your attention to detail and reliability will truly shine—this is your moment.

What you'll do

  • Shipment Handling & Repacking:

    Accurately handle, inspect, and repack incoming and outgoing diamond shipments in accordance with company protocols and international shipping standards.

  • Operational Support:

    Work closely with your two team members to manage the daily operations of the office, ensuring all logistics processes run smoothly and efficiently

  • Precision & Security:

    Maintain the highest level of precision, confidentiality, and security when dealing with high-value goods—attention to detail is non-negotiable in this role.

  • Team Collaboration:

    Collaborate with senior team members to align on priorities, share insights, and uphold our collective standards of excellence.

  • Process Improvement:

    Contribute ideas to improve workflows and increase operational efficiency as the company continues to scale rapidly.

  • Growth Mindset:

    Be proactive, reliable, and open to learning. This role offers strong internal growth potential for individuals who show initiative and dedication.

What you'll need for this entry-level role:

  • Strong Attention to Detail

  • Ability to repack/handle goods

  • Team-Oriented Mindset

  • Basic Administrative Skills

  • Trustworthiness & Discretion

Highly desirable

  • Experience working in high-security logistics environments, preferably with luxury goods, jewelry, or diamonds.

  • Familiarity with international shipping regulations and customs procedures.

  • Proficiency in basic logistics software or ERP systems (e.g. SAP, NetSuite, or similar).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Physically fit and able to handle small manual tasks as part of the shipment handling process.

  • A proactive, solution-oriented attitude with a willingness to grow within a fast-scaling organization.

What you'll get:

💸Competitive compensation

🍎Free lunch

🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning

jobs.title: Staff Engineer / Paris (W/M/X)
jobs.description:
Pioneer of online flash sales since 2001 and key player in European e-commerce, Veepee collaborates with over 7,000 brands to offer highly discounted products available for a limited time. Operating across various sectors, including fashion, home, wine, travel or beauty... Veepee achieved a turnover of 3.3 billion euros incl. VAT in 2024 and employs 5,000 staff members across 10 countries.

🎯 Level & Domain

Level:

Staff Engineer is IC4 on our engineering ladder:

  • Has worked as a Senior Developer in at least two product teams. 

  • Turns the tribe’s hardest, ill-framed problems into shipped business value. 

  • Lands in any product fast, de-risks the complex, and raises the bar across teams.

    • The Fastline:

    Each domain has its own Fastline: a small team of Staff Engineers working across all the products of the domain, in a highly agile, commando mode.

    The Fastline is transverse to the domain’s products: it is not attached to one product, but deployed wherever a domain needs senior engineering firepower the most.

    The Fastline takes on three kinds of work:

  • Complex features in existing products: deliver features too risky, cross-cutting or technically hard for a product team to absorb alongside its committed roadmap.

  • Legacy decommissioning: retire legacy systems safely, migrate their capabilities and data, and switch them off for good.

  • IS simplification: reduce the complexity of the tribe’s information system, remove duplication, and make the architecture easier to run and evolve.

    • Fastlines are attached to the Domain Lead, who sets their priorities based on business value, in coordination with the domains’ Lead ITs. Missions are short and outcome-driven: you join a topic, deliver, hand over to the owning product team, and move on to the next one. 


    🎯 TASK

    Strategic & Hard Problems

  • Take on the domain’s most difficult and strategic topics: legacy decommissioning, IS simplification, complex features in existing products.

  • Contribute, with the Architects, to the decommissioning of legacy systems end to end: map dependencies and data flows, design the migration path, run it without business disruption, and switch the legacy off.

  • Drive the simplification of the tribe’s information system: identify redundant components, unnecessary coupling and dead code, and remove them.

  • Deliver complex, cross-cutting features inside existing products, working hand in hand with their product teams.

    • Fast Onboarding & Delivery

  • Land in any product or codebase of the domain and become productive in days, not months.

  • Quickly understand the business context, the architecture, the constraints and the people involved in a topic.

  • Deliver early and often: integrate end to end first, sequence work from most unknown to least worrisome, and show tangible progress quickly.

  • Hand over cleanly to the owning product team: documentation, tests, runbooks and knowledge transfer, so that the team can run what you built.

    • Problem Framing & Business Partnership

  • Take ill-defined, poorly framed problems and turn them into clear, actionable plans.

  • Navigate between tech and business: understand the business stakes, challenge the need with a “how yes” mindset, and propose the simplest solution that delivers the value.

  • Partner with business teams, PMs/POs and Engineering Managers to shape the problem, identify rabbit holes, no-gos and hidden complexity, and agree on scope.

  • Think business value first: explain the value of every technical investment, legacy removal and simplification included.

  • Be the person the business can count on: reliable, transparent on risks, and committed to outcomes.

    • Engineering Excellence & Technical Leadership

  • Own the how end to end: architecture, libraries, data model, implementation, testing and deployment.

  • Write production code: you are hands-on and contribute heavily to the implementation.

  • Make sound technical trade-offs and document key decisions.

  • Raise the bar in the teams you work with: code quality, testing, operability, and AI-first practices.

  • Coach and mentor engineers along the way, and share knowledge across products.

  • Contribute to the domain’s technical vision and target architecture with the Lead IT and the domain’s Architects.

    • Run & Reliability

  • Live by “you build it, you run it”: ship stable, battle-tested software and take ownership of its run until it is handed over.

  • Make migrations and decommissioning safe: rollback plans, monitoring, data reconciliation, progressive switch-over.

  • Step in on critical incidents and complex production problems across the domain when your expertise is needed.

    • AI-First Ways of Working

  • Treat specifications and tests as IP: in an AI era where code is cheap, Veepee’s value moves from code to clear specifications and tests.

  • Use applied AI and prototyping to move faster: understand legacy codebases, generate migrations and tests, explore solutions.

  • Apply a “no roadmap without AI” mindset and spread AI-first practices across the products you work on.


    • 👉 What this role is not
  • Not a manager: you have no direct reports. You lead through expertise, influence and delivery, not hierarchy.

  • Not an ivory-tower architect: you do not draw diagrams and leave. You write code, ship to production and own the outcome.

  • Not attached to a single product: you go wherever the domain needs you most, and you move on once the job is done.

  • Not a spec coder: you do not need a detailed spec to start. A messy, poorly framed problem is your starting point.

  • Not a purely technical expert disconnected from the business: you understand the business, take initiative and drive every topic with a value-first mindset.


    • 👉 Requirements

  • Experience as a Senior Developer (IC3), or equivalent, in at least two product teams, with a strong track record of shipping working, tested software in production on complex systems.

  • Proven experience on hard, high-stakes topics: legacy migration and decommissioning, large refactorings, architecture simplification, or critical features in existing systems.

  • Deep technical expertise: architecture, system design, distributed systems, data modelling, and engineering best practices.

  • Hands-on and fast: able to dive into an unknown codebase and business context and deliver value quickly.

  • Strong business acumen: ability to understand a business domain, its stakes and KPIs, and to build trusted relationships with business teams.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills: comfortable with ambiguity, able to frame an ill-defined problem and find the simplest path to value.

  • High autonomy and ownership: you do not need to be told what to do, and you take full accountability for outcomes.

  • Hands-on with the “you build it, you run it” principle: operability, monitoring, on-call and SLAs.

  • Pragmatic understanding of applied AI and AI-first engineering (prototyping / vibe coding, AI-assisted legacy understanding, specifications and tests as IP).

  • Ability to influence without authority, and to coach and raise the level of the engineers around you.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration with PMs/POs, Engineering Managers, business teams, engineers, Architects, SREs, the Lead IT and the Domain Lead.

  • Open to internal Senior Developers (IC3) who meet these criteria, as well as external applications.

  • Master’s degree in Engineering / IT or equivalent.

  • Fluency in English, international environment.


    • ✅ BENEFITS
  • Variable bonus
  • Profit-sharing and incentive schemes
  • Remote work possible for up to 2 days per week
  • Online language-learning platform
  • Works Council (CSE) with a wide range of benefits
  • CESU vouchers (service vouchers) and holiday vouchers
  • Access to corporate dining facilities and smart fridges (Foodles, Kumo, Bolk)
  • Access to an on-site gym

jobs.title: Senior SEO & GEO Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.

 

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

 

Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.

 

We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands.

 

Who we’re looking for

Someone who can shape how travellers discover Interrail, whether they’re typing into a search engine or asking an AI assistant to plan their trip. Exploring Europe by rail is one of the most transformative ways to travel, and there’s a big, untapped opportunity to make it even easier. With SEO and GEO, you’ll help travellers get inspired, plan and book their next rail adventure with an Interrail Pass in fewer steps.

 

Also, it’s good to know that the team has agreed to meet in the office every Tuesday and Thursday, so you’ll be expected to be in the office on these days to work side by side with your colleagues.

 

What you’ll be doing

You’ll be joining the Growth team (in a nutshell: the people who turn traveller curiosity into journeys booked), reporting to our E-Commerce Lead.

 

You’ll own the end-to-end SEO and GEO strategy, so that Interrail is found, cited and recommended wherever travellers research rail travel in Europe. Working across content, product, engineering and PR/brand, you’ll turn search and AI visibility insight into meaningful, measurable growth.

 

Strategy and leadership

  • Own and scale a unified SEO and GEO strategy and roadmap, aligned to commercial goals across our priority markets.

  • Prioritise investment across markets and languages based on search demand, commercial opportunity and local traveller needs.

  • Be our internal expert on how AI is changing travel discovery, embedding SEO and GEO thinking across marketing, content, PR/brand and product.

  • Partner with engineering, content and product to get the right work prioritised and shipped.

Technical SEO and architecture

  • Own technical SEO for our large, complex site and set the technical roadmap with product and content.

  • Lead our SEO architecture: hreflang at scale, domain and subfolder strategy, and localisation quality across languages.

  • Make sure search engines and AI systems can access and understand the site, with the right structured data and clear, consistent information on passes, pricing and eligibility.

  • Own our crawler access policy for AI bots together with legal and engineering, balancing visibility against content protection.

GEO

  • Own our GEO strategy and roadmap: how we earn mentions, citations and recommendations across markets and languages.

  • Build our GEO measurement framework, tracking brand presence, citation share, share of voice against competitors and sentiment.

  • Spot recurring inaccuracies in AI-generated answers, fix them at the source with the relevant teams and track whether accuracy improves.

  • Partner with PR, partnerships and social to strengthen the off-site signals AI models rely on, from trusted travel publications to community presence and review platforms.

  • Measure and attribute AI-referred traffic and conversions, and run structured tests to build repeatable GEO playbooks.

  • Assess emerging opportunities, such as AI agents that plan and book travel, and advise on what Interrail needs to be ready.

Content and topical authority

  • Shape content strategy and topical authority across destinations, routes, guides and inspiration, balancing discovery with pass and booking intent.

  • Make sure our content performs in both search results and AI answers, with clear factual structure and original rail expertise worth citing.

  • Be the SEO and GEO advisor to the content team, building a shared roadmap that connects visibility opportunity to editorial output.

  • Set and govern content quality standards (briefs, structure, internal linking, E-E-A-T) and upskill the team in SEO and GEO best practice.

  • Identify gaps, cannibalisation and refresh opportunities, and advise on what to create, update, consolidate or retire.

Measurement and reporting

  • Forecast organic and AI-driven performance, set KPIs across both, and report clearly to senior stakeholders.

What success looks like

  • Non-brand searches make up a growing share of organic traffic and revenue across our priority markets.

  • A GEO measurement framework is live, and our citation share and share of voice in AI answers are improving against key competitors.

  • The SEO and GEO roadmap is agreed with product, engineering and content and delivered as planned, including website and CMS changes that launch without loss of organic visibility.

  • Recurring inaccuracies about passes, pricing and eligibility in AI answers are identified, fixed at the source and measurably reduced.

What we’re looking for

Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.

 

In terms of your experience and skills:

  • Demonstrated experience leading SEO strategy across content and technical, ideally in travel, e-commerce or a large content or marketplace environment.

  • Hands-on GEO experience, with examples of your approach, results, measurement limitations and the decisions that followed.

  • A working understanding of how AI search experiences select and cite sources, and how that differs from traditional ranking.

  • A strong track record in international and multilingual SEO at scale.

  • A solid technical foundation, including structured data, and the ability to influence engineering roadmaps.

  • Outstanding cross-functional collaboration: you align teams around a shared roadmap and take initiatives from idea to launch without direct authority, reviewing results together and applying the learnings.

  • A data-driven, commercial mindset: comfortable forecasting, sizing opportunity, attributing impact in a maturing channel and presenting to leadership.

  • A test-and-learn mindset, comfortable building new capabilities in a fast-changing environment.

  • Experience partnering closely with content, editorial, PR or brand teams.

  • Fluency with the core toolset: Google Search Console, GA4, an SEO platform such as Semrush or Ahrefs, a crawler such as Screaming Frog, log-analysis tools and GEO tracking tools.

  • Fluent English; another European language, ideally German, French, Italian or Spanish, is beneficial to have.

Our offer

  • A hybrid way of working, with some days each week in our Utrecht office and the rest from home.

  • A free NS train card, so you can travel across the Netherlands for work and in your free time.

  • A free Interrail Pass every year for you and a companion, so you can travel across Europe the way our travellers do.

  • Unlimited access to OpenUp, an online wellbeing platform.

  • A personal wellbeing allowance of up to €1,500.

  • A training allowance of up to €4,000 for learning that’s relevant to your role.

  • A variable annual bonus (target 4%), based on company and individual performance.

  • An annual team trip across Europe, so you see first-hand what our travellers experience.

  • The option to work from abroad for 20 days a year.

  • An annual leave package of 28 days, plus study days, volunteer days and a culture day.

  • Salary Scale: 60. Monthly gross salary (excluding 8% holiday allowance): €5,300 – €6,400 (full-time), based on experience.

Curious to apply?

Apply directly through our careers page.

 

  • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

 

If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

 

To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.

 

In the meantime

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

 

Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at

 

While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
Position Overview

Axelera AI is a fast-growing AI semiconductor company headquartered in Eindhoven, building high-performance, energy-efficient AI acceleration hardware and software, from the Metis AI platform for edge inference to next-generation AI processing units. We are scaling quickly: new customers, new partners, new markets, and a growing volume of complex commercial deals across the global semiconductor supply chain.

We are looking for an experienced commercial lawyer to be the engine of our commercial legal function. You will close deals, build the playbooks and processes that let the business move fast without taking on unmanaged risk, and lead how legal operates day to day, with AI in the loop so a lean team delivers more with less. This is a hands-on role with real scope to shape the function as it grows.

Key responsibilities:

Commercial contracting

  • Draft, review and negotiate a high volume of commercial agreements: customer, distribution, reseller and OEM/ODM agreements; sales terms and EULAs; supply and manufacturing agreements (foundry, OSAT, component suppliers); technology and IP licences; software and SaaS agreements; evaluation, early access and development agreements; R&D collaboration and consortium agreements; services and vendor agreements; and MOUs, LOIs and partnership terms.

  • Act as the trusted, pragmatic adviser to Sales, Product, Engineering, Operations and Finance, giving clear, commercial risk calls at pace.

  • Advise on key semiconductor and AI issues: IP ownership and licensing, warranties and liability caps, product liability, export controls and sanctions, data protection and the EU AI Act.

  • Support the CFO and Head of Legal on strategic matters, including corporate transactions and board-level work, as needed.

Playbooks and scale

  • Build AI-ready contract playbooks, fallback positions and approval matrices so AI tools and the business can handle routine deals with minimal Legal involvement.

  • Create and own a library of standard templates for our core agreement types (e.g. NDA, customer terms, evaluation, distributor, supplier) aligned to our risk appetite.

  • Train commercial teams on contract basics, negotiation positions and when to escalate to Legal.

Legal operations

  • Lead legal operations: intake and triage, prioritisation, SLAs and reporting on legal workload and turnaround.

  • Own the legal tech and AI stack: select, implement and continuously improve AI review and drafting tools, CLM, e-signature and the contract repository, automating repeatable work end to end.

  • Own contract lifecycle management, including obligation tracking, renewals and keeping contract records complete and up to date.

  • Set up clear policies and processes that scale with the company.

Collaboration

  • Work alongside, supervise and mentor a Junior Legal Counsel, allocating work and reviewing output.

  • Manage external counsel efficiently, including scope and budget, and determine which matters are best handled in-house.

  • Report to the Head of Legal (in the interim, the CFO) and help shape the future structure of the legal team.

Qualifications:

Essential

  • Qualified lawyer with 7+ years' PQE in commercial and corporate law, from a leading firm and/or in-house.

  • Substantial in-house experience in tech, semiconductors, hardware or deep tech, ideally at a scale-up.

  • A strong track record negotiating complex, high-value international contracts, including IP-heavy and supply chain deals.

  • Hands-on use of AI tools in daily legal work, plus experience building playbooks and processes that let a small team scale.

  • Commercial judgement that finds the route to yes, and the ability to explain risk simply to senior stakeholders.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, high volume and shifting priorities.

  • Fluent business English, our working and contract language.

Desirable

  • Semiconductor, AI or embedded systems experience (foundry, licensing, OEM deals).

  • Knowledge of export controls (EU dual-use, US EAR), sanctions and the EU AI Act.

  • Experience implementing CLM or AI contract tools, prompting, or building no-code automations.

  • Experience mentoring junior lawyers, or exposure to venture-backed companies and governance.

  • Dutch or another European language.

How We Work: AI-First Legal
We're building a lean legal function, not scaling by headcount. AI handles first-pass review, redlining, drafting and research, while lawyers focus on judgement and negotiation. Routine work is self-serve through templates and AI-assisted workflows. We measure turnaround and outcomes, and we use AI responsibly, with human review and clear guardrails on confidentiality and accuracy.

Location
Hybrid, with 2 days per week in our Amsterdam or Eindhoven office.

What we offer 

This is your chance to shape and be part of a dynamic, fast-growing, international organization. We offer an attractive compensation package, including a pension plan, extensive employee insurances and the option to get company shares.   

An open culture that supports creativity and continual innovation is awaiting you. Collaborative ownership and freedom with responsibility is characteristic for the way we act and work as a team. 

At Axelera AI, we wholeheartedly embrace equal opportunity and hold diversity in the highest regard. Our steadfast commitment is to cultivate a warm and inclusive environment that empowers and celebrates every member of our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in shaping the future of AI.

Axelera AI may at times work with external parties (such as recruiters, headhunters, or executive search firms) to support both publicly posted and confidential searches. Our hiring process never involves any payment from candidates, and we will never require you to use a particular paid service to be considered for a role. We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Opportunity

Prosus is continuing to evolve its business, product and investment activities, with ambitious plans to build, scale and grow technology-driven businesses and products globally.

We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and resourceful Executive Assistant to provide high-quality executive and operational support to three senior leaders: the Chief Product Officer, the Head of Ventures, and the Director of Strategy & Operations. You will play an important part in enabling these leaders to operate effectively, ensuring their time and priorities are managed efficiently and that the day-to-day running of their respective areas is seamless.

You will take ownership of complex calendars, international travel, meeting preparation, stakeholder coordination and administrative processes, while anticipating needs, managing competing priorities and identifying opportunities to improve how things are done. Working across different teams and functions, you will build strong relationships throughout the organisation and act as a trusted point of contact for both internal and external stakeholders.

We are looking for someone who combines exceptional organisational skills with sound judgement, discretion and a hands-on approach. Someone who enjoys being one step ahead, takes pride in making things happen and thrives in an environment where priorities can move quickly.

What You Will Do

Executive & Business Support

  • Provide proactive, high-quality executive assistance to the Chief Product Officer, Head of Ventures, and Director of Strategy & Operations.

  • Manage complex and frequently changing calendars, prioritising meetings, resolving scheduling conflicts and ensuring leaders make the best use of their time.

  • Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation, ground transportation, detailed itineraries and visa requirements.

  • Manage meeting logistics, including scheduling, preparing agendas, coordinating pre-reads and ensuring relevant materials are available ahead of time.

  • Capture key actions and follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure commitments and deliverables are progressing.

  • Act as a trusted first point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, handling requests with professionalism, sound judgement and discretion.

  • Manage expenses, invoices, budget tracking and other administrative processes, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company policies.

  • Handle confidential and sensitive information with the highest level of discretion and professionalism.

Stakeholder & Operational Coordination

  • Build strong working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders across Product, Ventures, Strategy & Operations and the wider Prosus organisation.

  • Coordinate leadership meetings, workshops, offsites and other business events, managing logistics and ensuring smooth execution.

  • Support the coordination of cross-functional initiatives, helping ensure meetings, communications and follow-up actions are organised and delivered effectively.

  • Assist with onboarding and administrative arrangements for new team members and other relevant stakeholders across the supported functions.

  • Coordinate with HR, Finance, IT, Workplace, Legal and other internal teams to resolve requests and ensure efficient day-to-day operations.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify administrative processes, improve ways of working and create greater efficiency for the executives and their teams.

  • Provide general operational support across the three functions, stepping in where needed to keep priorities moving and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

Who You Are

You are a highly organised, proactive and solutions-oriented professional who enjoys working closely with senior leaders and making their lives easier.

You naturally think several steps ahead, have a strong sense of ownership and are comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment. You know when to take initiative, when to escalate and how to exercise sound judgement without needing constant direction.

You are confident in engaging with senior stakeholders, build relationships easily and communicate clearly and professionally. You are equally comfortable managing the finer details of a complex travel itinerary as you are coordinating a senior leadership meeting or resolving an unexpected scheduling challenge.

Above all, you are dependable, discreet and take pride in delivering excellent support. You enjoy being behind the scenes, making things happen and creating the conditions for others to perform at their best.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience in an Executive Assistant, Senior Personal Assistant or Executive Business Partner role, ideally supporting multiple senior executives.

  • Experience working in a fast-paced, international and complex business environment, preferably within technology, investment or a corporate organisation.

  • Exceptional organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex calendars and competing priorities.

  • Strong experience coordinating international travel, meetings, leadership events and other executive-level logistics.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to interact professionally with senior stakeholders and external partners.

  • A proactive, hands-on mindset, with the ability to anticipate needs, solve problems independently and take ownership of tasks from start to finish.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy while working at pace.

  • High levels of discretion, integrity and professionalism when handling confidential and sensitive information.

  • Comfortable working across different teams and functions, building relationships and navigating a complex organisational environment.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other relevant productivity and collaboration tools.

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.


We want you as a Cross-Functional Mechanical Engineer to bring hands-on structural design experience and sound engineering judgement to the mechanical development and verification of Nyx. With a strong system-level mindset, you will support subsystem teams in developing robust designs, resolving mechanical challenges, and substantiating the integrity of critical hardware throughout the development lifecycle.

A key focus of your role will be to develop and consolidate the mechanical justifications supporting NASA requirements compliance and Safety Review Panel (SRP) activities. Working with subsystem owners and the safety and certification teams, you will establish the technical basis for allowable damage and failure criteria across critical vehicle components. You will combine direct technical contributions with practical guidance to engineers and suppliers, connecting component-level assessments with vehicle-level requirements and safety considerations.

You will be part of the Nyx Design Office Team, within the Cross-Functional Mechanical team, and will report to the Integrated Mechanical Sizing & Assurance Team Leader.


Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Integration

  • Provide hands-on structural design expertise and technical guidance across subsystems, supporting mechanical integrity and consistency at vehicle level.

  • Assess load paths, interfaces, stiffness, and boundary conditions to understand how mechanical, pressure, and thermo-mechanical loads are transferred through components, attachments, and the vehicle structure.

  • Perform and review mechanical assessments using engineering calculations, finite element analysis (FEA), and test evidence, challenging assumptions and identifying the failure modes that drive design decisions.

  • Support subsystem owners in translating high-level mechanical requirements into subsystem and component specifications, maintaining traceability and accounting for vehicle-level interactions.

Compliance & Verification

  • Develop and document mechanical justifications for allowable damage and failure criteria for critical Nyx hardware, in collaboration with the relevant subsystem and discipline specialists.

  • Establish the supporting rationale through analysis and test evidence, addressing relevant strength, stability, fatigue, fracture, damage tolerance, and residual performance considerations as applicable to each component.

  • Support NASA SRP activities by preparing mechanical justification, contributing to compliance matrices and verification evidence, and addressing technical questions and review actions with the safety and certification teams.

  • Review qualification strategies, test plans, and reports for consistency with applicable NASA requirements, agreed standards, and the assumptions used in mechanical analyses.

  • Participate in design reviews, identify gaps in mechanical justification, and recommend design changes or additional verification activities to resolve them.

Supplier Interactions and Team Collaboration

  • Review supplier designs, structural analyses, and verification documentation to assess technical maturity and consistency with subsystem and vehicle requirements at key milestones.

  • Provide practical technical guidance to suppliers and subsystem owners, resolving mechanical issues and following technical actions through to closure.

  • Facilitate technical alignment between subsystem teams, structural analysis, materials and processes, testing, safety and certification, and suppliers, ensuring that assumptions, interfaces, and responsibilities are clearly understood.

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in mechanical or structural engineering within the aerospace or aeronautics industry.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and justifying structural or mechanical hardware through development and qualification, in aerospace or aeronautics.

  • Ability to perform and critically review engineering calculations and FEA, interpret CAD models and engineering drawings, and relate analysis assumptions to the physical design and test configuration.

  • Understanding of mechanical requirements flow-down, qualification and verification processes, and traceable compliance evidence, together with familiarity with applicable space standards and NASA requirements.

  • Demonstrated ability to guide engineers and suppliers through complex mechanical problems while considering subsystem interfaces and vehicle-level consequences.

Additional experience we would value:

  • Direct involvement in NASA safety reviews or SRP submissions, particularly the preparation and defence of mechanical qualification and the closure of review actions.

  • Experience with pressurized structures, fluid piping, radiators, or propulsion hardware, and with fracture control, damage tolerance, or structural test campaigns.

Skills and Behaviors:

  • System-Level Thinking: Ability to connect component-level design and failure mechanisms with subsystem interfaces, vehicle performance, and safety objectives.

  • Engineering Judgement: Ability to identify governing load paths and failure modes, challenge modelling assumptions, and distinguish between a numerical result and a sound mechanical justification.

  • Influence & Decision-Making: Ability to guide technical decisions across teams and suppliers through clear reasoning and evidence, while working within agreed technical responsibilities.

  • Mentorship: Ability to share practical design experience and help engineers strengthen their structural understanding and verification practices.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
Most CFOs inherit a finance function.

This one gets to build it.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer — quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.

Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We hold the power of attorney for every customer, take decisions, do the work, and take legal responsibility for the result.

The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. That means making correct and fair employment simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters.

Where we stand

Thousands of clients rely on us. Last year alone, over CHF 200 million ran through our platform. We are at CHF 7 million ARR and growing. The Swiss business is profitable. We have acquired two new businesses in the last twelve months. A hungry team of over 50 people (and 5 dogs) in offices in Switzerland, Germany and the United Kingdom. And we are raising our next round.

We do not have a finance function yet. We have an external accountant, a signed audit, and a CEO and COO who know exactly what they need to run this company — but cannot build it alone.

That is the opening.

Tasks

What you will own

Everything financial:

  • Banking architecture across multiple currencies, countries, and entities. Monthly close that actually closes on time.
  • Compliance in multiple jurisdictions via external partners you recruit and manage.
  • The financial diligence in our roll-up strategy when we acquire — and the structuring of acquisition financing when deals need to be funded.
  • A financial model that investors love to look at. The data room when we raise.

You will report to David (CEO) and work closely with Lad (COO), who owns the P&L and will be your closest counterpart on the operational side. You will present to the board. You will be in the room for every capital allocation decision.

There is no team. There is no process to maintain. There is a blank sheet and a business that is ready to run properly.

The first year

Your first year at quinn is one of the rare opportunities where you get to make every decision that matters. Which tools. Which banks. Which partners. How we report, how we model, how we show up to investors. All of it is yours to design.

You will spend the first months getting under the hood — taking over the books, understanding the gaps, and fixing what needs fixing first. You will build the reporting infrastructure that gives leadership real visibility to steer the company across every product and revenue stream.

You will analyze the first potential merger and acquisition targets and sit in rooms where the financial direction of the company gets decided, and you will be the person with the numbers.

By the end of the year, you will have built something real: a finance function that works, a roll-up strategy that has financial legs, and a leadership team that trusts you completely. Most people at this level spend years waiting for that kind of ownership. Here it happens within months.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You have been CFO or Head of Finance at a scale-up — a SaaS, marketplace, or tech-enabled services company. You have worked across more than one international market. You are comfortable closing the books yourself, not just reviewing what others produce. You have built financial infrastructure before — not inherited it.

You are equally at home in B2C and B2B — and you understand what it means to manage the unit economics, reporting, and compliance obligations for both within a single business.

You think in MRR, ARR, NRR, CAC payback, and LTV:CAC ratio. You have worked with investors. You understand what a roll-up strategy looks like financially, and you have the accounting basics to back it up. You know the difference between managing a finance function and doing the finance — and you are built for the latter.

Most importantly: You want this. Not a senior finance role at a large company. This one. The blank sheet, the multiple markets, the acquisitions to integrate, the round to prepare, the opportunity. The kind of thing you only get to do once.

The Team

We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process, a lot of hierarchy, or a lot of patience for people who need it. We do have a profitable core business, a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action

The CFO is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who looks at this and thinks: Finally!

Please apply exclusively via join — other forms of application will not be considered.

Je adviseert organisaties over SOFOS 360, onze software voor het registreren en beheren van gevaarlijke stoffen. Daarnaast werk je met Chemwatch, een internationaal toonaangevende softwareoplossing waarvoor ITIS Products exclusief partner is binnen de Benelux.

jobs.title: (Senior) Recruiter - Growing Impact Scale Up
jobs.description:
Join us in Revolutionizing Supply Chains
We’re a fast-growing SaaS scale-up on a mission to shape a sustainable future for the food industry. With four years of continuous 100% year-on-year growth, our team is expanding quickly. We’re looking for a proactive, highly organised Recruiter to help us find the people who will drive that growth, and to help shape how we work as we scale. Join us and shape the future of food sustainability with us!

About Simvia

Ensuring responsible supply chains is one of the largest challenges of our time. At Simvia we are on a path to enable the food and consumer goods industry to become a force for good, by making it simple to prove that what we eat and use is safe, compliant, and sustainable. 

Several of Europe's largest retailers, from Albert Heijn to Edeka, have joined Simvia together with their suppliers, and our network now spans more than 200,000 suppliers in 130 countries. AI gives us a strong tailwind: our network holds unique data, and much of the manual work in compliance can now be automated. We are growing rapidly and keep scaling with a driven, international team of 75+ people in the heart of Amsterdam. 

About this role

You will be our first in-house Recruiter. There is no recruitment playbook yet, so you build it: the process, the guardrails and the habits that let us hire fast and well as we scale. That calls for someone who thinks "I'll find a way" rather than "what's the rule here?" 

Sourcing is the heart of the job. Most of your impact comes from finding and convincing great people who were not looking. Every person you bring in shapes the company we become, so we want someone who lives our culture, not only someone who can describe it. 

Who thrives here

Our culture is driven and kind, and it only works if you bring both. 

Driven by the mission. You set ambitious goals, own the outcome, and welcome a high bar. 

Frank. You say what you think and would rather hear the truth than a comfortable story. 

Open. You ask for feedback and change your mind when the facts change. 

Trusting. You build real relationships and give others room to own their work. 

If this sounds more draining than energizing, that is a useful signal too. 

What you will work on

  • Sourcing and approaching great people across sales, customer success, product and engineering, through LinkedIn, referrals and cold calls, so most of our hires come from you rather than agencies 

  • Building our recruitment process from scratch: clear steps, interview templates and scorecards that every hiring manager follows 

  • Running several hiring processes at once, from role profile to signed offer, with candidates always knowing where they stand 

  • Holding hiring managers, senior leaders included, to agreed timelines and fast feedback 

  • Tracking time to hire, source effectiveness and funnel conversion, and using the numbers to improve how we hire 

  • Helping our People & Culture team with in-house events and office life in quieter hiring periods 

What you bring

  • 3+ years as a recruiter, in-house or agency, with hires across SaaS or tech roles from sales to R&D 

  • Real sourcing strength: direct approach and cold calls give you energy, and you can point to hires you found yourself 

  • A builder's mindset: you enjoy setting up processes, templates and guardrails where none exist yet 

  • Highly organized: you run many roles and steps at once without dropping anything 

  • You enjoy speed, and you are assertive with senior stakeholders while staying warm with candidates 

  • You already use AI and automation in your work and are curious about the next tool

  • Fluent English, written and spoken 

Nice to have

  • German and/or Dutch, German being the most useful 

  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up 

  • Experience with an ATS and LinkedIn Recruiter 

What we offer

  • A high-paced organization with room to grow your career 

  • A meaningful mission: help the food and consumer goods industry become a force for good 

  • Training and support, a pension contribution and travel reimbursement 

  • Fresh lunch every day, monthly Thirsty Thursdays, hackathons, boat parties and our annual dance event 

  • At least three days per week in our Amsterdam city center office, with two rooftop terraces 

How we hire

An intro call with our People & Culture team, a conversation with the hiring manager, an assignment, a culture conversation and an offer. Every process includes an assignment, because we would rather see your work than hear about it. We move fast and keep you informed at every step. 

Diversity & Inclusion at Simvia

We hire people with different backgrounds, cultures, and views because it makes our work better. Whoever you are, wherever you are from, whoever you love and whatever you believe in, you are welcome here. 

 

Questions about this vacancy? Reach out to our People & Culture team at .

jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer COO
jobs.description:
At Vio, we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites so that they can find the best place, at the best price, anywhere in the world.

Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence.

With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust.

Who we’re looking for

We are looking for an experienced Chief Operating Officer (COO) to join our Leadership Team and help us scale our booking operations, drive efficiency and deliver a best-in-class experience for our travelers.

Reporting to Oz , Our CEO, and joining Vio's Leadership Team, you'll be hired into the full organisation with a clear first focus: our booking (OTA) business. You'll lead Customer Support, OTA Finance, Payments and Legal, and work closely with our Product and Tech leads to optimise how we scale, simultaneously reducing our transactional and operational costs.

What you will do:

  • Scale our booking operations from ~4k bookings per day towards 20k–40k by 2028

  • Reduce our transactional and operational costs through continuous improvement, automation and smarter processes

  • Raise the quality of our user experience to match the best in the industry

  • Make sure our business operates smoothly across multiple jurisdictions

  • Support the scaling of our booking operations while limiting our risk exposure

  • Lead and develop your team: our Heads of Customer Support, OTA Finance and Payments and our Legal Counsel

Who you are:

  • A senior operations leader with experience scaling – not just operating at scale – ideally in a leadership position at a 500+ FTE organisation

  • Highly structured and analytically strong; data-fluent and comfortable making complex decisions in ambiguous situations

  • A proven track record of driving efficiency through continuous improvement, ideally in an online travel marketplace or accommodation distribution organisation

  • A pragmatic, flexible problem solver who fits operations to business needs rather than following frameworks or 'what we've done before'

  • Someone who simplifies for others, builds strong relationships and can hold critical lines

  • Experienced working in founder-led organisations and stepping into new, previously unowned areas

  • Travel industry experience is a big plus (especially flights / packages); B2C experience preferred, B2B welcome

  • Experience collaborating with enterprise partners is a real plus

Why join us now?

  • We’re one of the fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of millions of travelers each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of product features.

  • In 2026, we underwent a company-wide rebrand and launched our first StoryTelling marketing campaign in the UK. This was the next step in our commitment to help travelers book like insiders, and to establish Vio as a consumer-facing, creative brand.

  • The mobile applications (iOS and Android) we launched in 2023 have been a big success, reaching 5 million installs and earning strong customer reviews.

  • We’re a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives, with a commitment to the traveler above all else.

  • We reward our employees for the value they create by granting Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

What we offer:

  • Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture that promotes knowledge sharing, trust, and transparency.

  • A great compensation package, perks, and benefits – including significant stock appreciation rights.

  • Flexible time off, with as many holidays as you need, and a chance to work remotely.

  • We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden.

  • We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins, with company events in Amsterdam and abroad.

  • A budget for your home office

  • Access to free mental health support via OpenUp

We encourage people from all ethnic groups, genders, sexualities, ages, and abilities to apply. If this job description resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you.
